seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A supercomputer developed by reclusive billionaire and software genius Harold Finch analyzes data patterns in surveillance for the U.S. government to identify impending acts of terrorism. But the computer, known only as "The Machine", can also identify ordinary people who are about to be involved in violent crimes. Can those crimes be stopped before they take place? Secretly tapping into The Machine, Finch and ex-CIA agent John Reese use vigilante tactics and state-of-the-art technology to identify the soon-to-be victims and prevent the crimes from occuring. Meanwhile, two NYPD detectives Joss Carter and Lionel Fusco are drawn into the cases and the mystery surrounding the two covert crime fighters.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: When the social security number of a young prosecutor comes up, Reese and Finch work together to figure out if their person of interest is the victim or perpetrator.

episodes.name: Ghosts
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch question the machine's reliability when they are asked to investigate a teenager who was killed years earlier; Finch remembers the origin of the machine.

episodes.name: Mission Creep
episodes.overview: Reese goes undercover to find the threat surrounding the next person on Finch's list: a young army veteran named Joey Durban.

episodes.name: Cura Te Ipsum
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch get some help from Detective Fusco  as they surveil their latest POI, Dr. Megan Tillman, while she’s on call and after hours to unravel the threat surrounding the promising young physician.

episodes.name: Judgement
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch have the added challenge of investigating a Person of Interest who wants nothing to do with their brand of vigilante justice.

episodes.name: The Fix
episodes.overview: Reese becomes romantically involved with the newest Person of Interest: an attractive woman who isn't all that she seems.

episodes.name: Witness
episodes.overview: The Machine identifies a school teacher who witnessed a mob hit as their next POI and Reese and Finch rush to save his life.

episodes.name: Foe
episodes.overview: When Reese and Finch discover that their latest POI has connections to Cold War Soviet espionage circles, they quickly learn how covert ops were handled in a world before The Machine.

episodes.name: Get Carter
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch’s game of cat and mouse with Detective Carter becomes infinitely more complicated when The Machine declares that she is their newest POI.

episodes.name: Number Crunch
episodes.overview: As Detective Carter deals with the fallout from her recent encounter with Reese and Finch, The Machine ups the ante for the duo by giving them four Social Security numbers instead of one.

episodes.name: Super
episodes.overview: Reese is confined to a wheelchair recovering from his gunshot wound, but Finch sets him up in an apartment where he’s to keep an eye on the Super, who is their latest POI. Also, Finch approaches Carter and gives her a POI to show her what they do.

episodes.name: Legacy
episodes.overview: When Carter finally comes face-to-face with Reese, he urges her to join forces to help with their latest POI, a scrappy young woman from the wrong side of the tracks who turned her life around and became a lawyer.

episodes.name: Root Cause
episodes.overview: The Machine gives Reese and Finch the number of a down-and-out man who has been pushed too far, and they're forced to turn to former Person of Interest, Zoe Morgan, for help.

episodes.name: Wolf and Cub
episodes.overview: The Machine identifies Darren, a teenager whose brother was just murdered, as the next POI. Meanwhile, Finch is growing concerned that the son of his former business partner is dangerously close to finding out about the Machine.

episodes.name: Blue Code
episodes.overview: Reese discovers there’s more to the story after he infiltrates a smuggling ring to get close to his latest POI.

episodes.name: Risk
episodes.overview: The Machine leads Reese and Finch to Wall Street when a sharp young trader at a major investment bank becomes embroiled in a multi-million dollar financial scam.

episodes.name: Baby Blue
episodes.overview: When The Machine spits out the number of a 6-month-old baby, Reese and Finch turn into overly protective parents – with an arsenal at their disposal. Meanwhile, when Elias resurfaces, Detective Carter begins to question her new allegiance with Reese and Finch.

episodes.name: Identity Crisis
episodes.overview: The Machine's latest number presents a unique challenge for Reese and Finch since the person has virtually no digital footprint - and appears to be leading a double life.

episodes.name: Flesh and Blood
episodes.overview: When The Machine spits out five numbers, naming the Don of each of New York’s crime families, Reese and Finch suspect Elias is planning to eliminate his competition.

episodes.name: Matsya Nyaya
episodes.overview: Reese goes undercover as an armored car company employee, and faces memories from his past with the CIA.

episodes.name: Many Happy Returns
episodes.overview: Finch gives Reese his birthday off so that his partner doesn't have to face a Number that is tied to Reese's past.

episodes.name: No Good Deed
episodes.overview: The newest POI’s curiosity could spell his doom when he finds himself embroiled in a dark government conspiracy – one that Finch is all too familiar with. Meanwhile, Reese uncovers something revealing about Finch’s past.

episodes.name: Firewall
episodes.overview: As the clock ticks down, Reese winds up trapped with his POI in the most heavily surveilled part of the city, forced to rely on the help of Finch, Carter and Fusco to fend off the FBI, corrupt cops and a slew of old foes.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The Machine identifies another gripping season's worth of potential crimes that must be stopped. Adversaries from Reese's undercover past and Finch's government work threaten the team's crime-fighting mission and anonymity. Meanwhile, Detectives Carter and Fusco face down FBI probes and the dangerous tentacles of the police conspiracy known as "HR".

episodes.name: The Contingency
episodes.overview: With Finch missing – kidnapped by his hacker nemesis, Root, Reese enlists Detectives Carter and Fusco to get his friend back, Meanwhile, The Machine never sleeps, disseminating a new number to Reese.

episodes.name: Bad Code
episodes.overview: The Machine delivers the number of a cold case that leads Reese ever closer to catching up with Finch and his kidnapper, Root.

episodes.name: Masquerade
episodes.overview: With Finch back in the Library, Reese returns to field work, only to face his toughest case yet – protecting the privileged daughter of a Brazilian diplomat.

episodes.name: Triggerman
episodes.overview: When The Machine gives them the number of a mob enforcer whose life becomes endangered, Reese and Finch must decide whether to intervene or allow karma to balance the scales of justice. Meanwhile, Finch seeks aid from an unlikely source.

episodes.name: Bury the Lede
episodes.overview: Reese must protect an investigative journalist through surreptitious means to avoid becoming part of her story.

episodes.name: The High Road
episodes.overview: Reese goes undercover in an idyllic neighborhood when The Machine’s latest number sends him to the suburbs.

episodes.name: Critical
episodes.overview: The Machine gives Finch and Reese the number of a brilliant surgeon, but they soon discover that a resourceful third party has raised the stakes for this POI, forcing them to turn to an unlikely source for help.

episodes.name: Til Death
episodes.overview: The team is spread thin when a husband and wife’s numbers both come up

episodes.name: C.O.D.
episodes.overview: When the machine names a New York cabdriver as a person of interest, any of his passengers could be a part of the impending crime.

episodes.name: Shadow Box
episodes.overview: As the FBI pursues "the man in the suit," Reese is even more determined to protect the latest person of interest after learning she is the sister of a soldier who was killed in action.

episodes.name: 2πR
episodes.overview: Finch goes under cover to protect a youth who reminds him of himself; Carter goes on a dangerous mission for the FBI.

episodes.name: Prisoner's Dilemma
episodes.overview: Carter tries to help Reese by engaging in mental warfare with the FBI; Reese has encounters with old and new enemies; Detective Fusco must protect supermodel Karolina Kurkova, the latest person of interest.

episodes.name: Dead Reckoning
episodes.overview: Reese is abducted by a former acquaintance planning a massive and potentially deadly act of cyber-warfare.

episodes.name: One Percent
episodes.overview: Finch and Reese meet their match: a tech billionaire whose curiosity and endless resources could expose their identities and ruin their efforts to save his life.

episodes.name: Booked Solid
episodes.overview: As Reese and Finch try to save a hotel maid's life, they encounter a litany of suspects; Detective Carter considers a significant offer from the FBI.

episodes.name: Relevance
episodes.overview: A lethal government operative who tracks and stops terrorist threats before they occur finds herself on the run – and the new focus of Reese and Finch's attention. However, their pursuit proves to be their most formidable when they discover that her remarkable skill set equals their own.

episodes.name: Proteus
episodes.overview: As Finch and Reese try to protect six people simultaneously, clues lead them to a coastal town; when a storm forces Finch and Reese to seek shelter in a police station with a group of locals, they realize a killer may be in their midst.

episodes.name: All In
episodes.overview: Finch and Reese head to Atlantic City to protect the latest person of interest, an elderly gambler; Carter tries to clear another detective's name.

episodes.name: Trojan Horse
episodes.overview: Finch infiltrates a tech corporation to gather intel on an executive whose number has come up; Carter questions Beecher's integrity.

episodes.name: In Extremis
episodes.overview: When a person of interest is poisoned, Finch and Reese only have 24 hours to identify the toxin and find the person responsible; Detective Fusco's past catches up to him.

episodes.name: Zero Day
episodes.overview: When a virus causes the machine to malfunction, numbers are issued irregularly; the team searches for an extremely elusive tech millionaire.

episodes.name: God Mode
episodes.overview: Finch and Reese team up with unexpected allies as they race to fix the machine; as Detective Carter tries to apprehend Cal Beecher's murderer, she finds herself up against HR -- a criminal organization.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The team suffers a devastating loss and confront staggering challenges. Adapting to the next evolution of The Machine, now completely self-governed and hidden from all, Finch and Reese team with rogue agent Sameen Shaw to save lives and seek justice, but their missions now threaten to tear them apart. Joss Carter and Lionel Fusco finally unravel the criminal police conspiracy "HR" - but at a tragic cost. And former cyber-enemy — and now highly tuned confederate of The Machine — Root becomes an unpredictable ally when the team learns a second surveillance apparatus to rival The Machine is on the verge of activation.

episodes.name: Liberty
episodes.overview: The Machine, now completely self-governed with its whereabouts unknown, resumes giving Finch its "irrelevant" numbers for people in danger, which include a U.S. naval officer in town for Fleet Week. However, with so many sailors flooding the streets of New York City, finding the officer in time presents an even bigger challenge for Reese and Shaw.

episodes.name: Nothing to Hide
episodes.overview: The number comes up for an Internet entrepreneur in the business of eliminating people's privacy, but finds his own being rapidly stripped away. As his life spirals out of control, Reese tries to protect him while Finch calls on Shaw, Carter and Fusco for help finding whoever is after him.

episodes.name: Lady Killer
episodes.overview: The team suspects the latest number to be a potential stalker/ killer. Root plots her escape from the institution and gives her psychiatrist a big surprise.

episodes.name: Reasonable Doubt
episodes.overview: The team must figure out if a prominent lawyer orchestrated the murder of her husband or if she is being framed; Carter is spotted with Reese by her new partner.

episodes.name: Razgovor
episodes.overview: Shaw must stay close to a 10-year-old girl with highly developed surveillance skills when she is identified by the machine; Carter's mission could be exposed.

episodes.name: Mors Praematura
episodes.overview: After being freed from her confinement to the psych ward, Root needs Shaw's help with a directive from the machine; Finch and Reese look into a mild-mannered investigator.

episodes.name: The Perfect Mark
episodes.overview: The team is met with surprises during an investigation into a hypnotherapist; an antiquities dealer has ties to a crime organization.

episodes.name: Endgame
episodes.overview: The machine gives Finch 38 numbers at once; information about Carter's past is revealed.

episodes.name: The Crossing
episodes.overview: The battle to bring a crime organization to justice reaches a new level; Reese's number comes up in the machine.

episodes.name: The Devil's Share
episodes.overview: As the POI team seeks justice for Carter’s murder, Finch realizes one of his team members may go one step too far in order to end the war with HR. Also, The Machine gives out the number for NYPD Officer Patrick Simmons, one of the crime organization’s key players.

episodes.name: Lethe
episodes.overview: Flashbacks to Finch’s adolescence provide insight into his creation of The Machine. Also, the team receives the number of an already dying man, and Reese leaves the POI team behind in the aftermath of the war with the crime organization, HR.

episodes.name: Aletheia
episodes.overview: Multiple enemies converge on the POI team as they protect a dying man whose number has come up. They struggle to keep their enemies at bay but without Reese, who has left them and their mission behind following the tragic war with HR, being down one man could have catastrophic repercussions for the team.

episodes.name: 4C
episodes.overview: Reese boards an international flight in an attempt to put the team and the past behind him, but is angered when he realizes his travel plans have been manipulated.

episodes.name: Provenance
episodes.overview: Reese rejoins Finch in New York, but when the team receives the number of a highly skilled antiquities thief, a surprising turn of events finds them planning a heist which could land them all in jail.

episodes.name: Last Call
episodes.overview: Finch goes undercover in an emergency call center to protect a 911 operator, but it soon becomes clear that the threat reaches further than the team could have anticipated.

episodes.name: RAM
episodes.overview: The secrets of Finch’s operation before he enlisted Reese are revealed, including shocking ties to present-day events.
The Machine assigns Root to seek out a janitor with a mysterious past, but when her very presence puts his life in danger, Finch also receives his number.

episodes.name: Allegiance
episodes.overview: Finch and Reese must delve into the murky waters of international politics when they are given the number of a former government contractor who is stalking a UN diplomat. Also, an enemy attempts to gain an upper hand on Root.

episodes.name: Most Likely To...
episodes.overview: Reese and Shaw pose as alumni at a high school reunion in order to keep eyes on the latest POI. Meanwhile, Finch and Fusco travel to Washington, D.C., to investigate the motivations behind Vigilance’s latest attack.

episodes.name: Death Benefit
episodes.overview: Reese poses as a Secret Service agent to get close to the latest POI, a U.S. congressman who may hold the key to derailing Decima’s plans to bring a second Machine online.

episodes.name: Beta
episodes.overview: As Decima uses Samaritan’s feeds to hunt Reese and Shaw, Greer exploits Finch’s greatest weakness in an attempt to lure him out of hiding: his love for his former fiancée, Grace Hendricks.

episodes.name: A House Divided
episodes.overview: When an unknown entity prevents The Machine from seeing the full picture of an impending catastrophic event, it sends the team five separate numbers to help them piece together the bigger picture. Meanwhile, Root’s team of hackers arrives in New York.

episodes.name: Deus Ex Machina
episodes.overview: The team takes desperate action in its race to prevent the malevolent AI program Samaritan from coming online and making them its first targets. Meanwhile, the months-long battle with the anti-surveillance terrorist group Vigilance comes to a shocking conclusion.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Although they’ve saved countless lives thanks to The Machine’s omniscience, John Reese and Harold Finch, along with lethal operative Sameen Shaw and unpredictable cyber-hacker Root now face an uncertain future. With a second machine — Samaritan — now online, the elusive team are now targets themselves, hiding in plain sight. The only thing more frightening than the ruthless Decima organization calling the shots is leaving those decisions up to an untested Machine. Facing a dangerous tomorrow, the POI team must find a way to outsmart Samaritan, an all-seeing, all-powerful artificial intelligence that’s self-governing, continually evolving and growing stronger every day.

episodes.name: Panopticon
episodes.overview: Forced to take on new identities provided by Root, the team members try to adapt to their new lives. However, some find it hard to ignore The Machine's numbers, which puts them all at risk of being detected by Samaritan.

episodes.name: Nautilus
episodes.overview: Despite not wanting to help with the new numbers, Finch's interest is piqued when the newest person of interest turns out to be a brilliant college student involved with a mysterious scavenger hunt.

episodes.name: Wingman
episodes.overview: Finch recruits Fusco to stick close to the latest POI, a professional 'wingman', but learning how to approach women soon becomes the least of his worries. Reese must find a way to play by the rules at his new day job. The Machine sends Finch and Root on a mysterious errand.

episodes.name: Brotherhood
episodes.overview: Reese's cover job as a detective at the NYPD becomes complicated when the young brother and sister he's protecting become targets of a gang investigation.

episodes.name: Prophets
episodes.overview: While Reese is forced to go to counseling for his violent tendencies, Root, Shaw and Finch try to help a new POI.

episodes.name: Pretenders
episodes.overview: Reese, Shaw and Fusco must protect a unassuming office worker who stumbles into a dangerous conspiracy while moonlighting as fake detective. Finch travels to Hong Kong as part of his academic cover identity.

episodes.name: Honor Among Thieves
episodes.overview: Shaw joins a team of international thieves in order to keep tabs on the latest POI, but an unexpected turn of events puts her in danger of being detected by Samaritan.  Also, Finch and Root undertake a dangerous sabotage mission.

episodes.name: Point of Origin
episodes.overview: Reese volunteers as an NYPD police academy instructor in order to keep an eye on a talented young officer whose suspicious actions make him question her motives. Meanwhile, Martine – armed with information from Samaritan – hunts a member of the team.

episodes.name: The Devil You Know
episodes.overview: Reese must save Elias from the Brotherhood. He can't get any help from Root or Shaw since Shaw's cover is blown and Root is escorting her to underground.

episodes.name: The Cold War
episodes.overview: Samaritan shows its power by erasing crime from the city for a day in an attempt to force The Machine out of hiding.

episodes.name: If-Then-Else
episodes.overview: Samaritan launches a cyber-attack on the stock exchange, forcing the team to risk their lives in a desperate mission to stop a global economic catastrophe.

episodes.name: Control-Alt-Delete
episodes.overview: Control, who oversees the handling of relevant numbers for the government, begins to question the methods and intentions of the Samaritan program. Also, alarming news reports of a pair of vigilantes rampaging through the Northeast begin to surface.

episodes.name: M.I.A.
episodes.overview: Root and Reese investigate a small town in upstate New York that holds the key to Shaw's location... and whether she's dead or alive.

episodes.name: Guilty
episodes.overview: When the Machine arranges for Finch to sit on the jury of a murder trial, he begins to suspect that a fellow juror is set to rig the proceedings. Meanwhile, Reese begins to open up to the department’s therapist.

episodes.name: Q&A
episodes.overview: Reese tries to protect a software programmer with a mysterious second life, but it’s unclear which side of her life the threat is coming from. Meanwhile, Claire, a young hacker whom Finch tried to protect from Samaritan, reaches out to him for aid.

episodes.name: Blunt
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch must protect Harper, a street-smart grifter, when her plan to steal cash from a medical marijuana dispensary goes up in smoke.

episodes.name: Karma
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch try to protect a psychologist whose unorthodox methods for helping his patients find closure could cost him dearly. Meanwhile, flashbacks reveal Finch’s fragile state in the days following the bombing that killed his best friend, Nathan Ingram.

episodes.name: Skip
episodes.overview: Reese must protect a bounty hunter who refuses to allow the potential threat to her life sway her from the relentless pursuit of her target. Also, Finch tries to set the plan he began in Shanghai in motion.

episodes.name: Search and Destroy
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch scramble to protect a software CEO when his behavior becomes increasingly erratic following a hacker attack that reveals all his secrets and unravels his life.

episodes.name: Terra Incognita
episodes.overview: Reese finds himself on a dangerous personal journey when he takes on a homicide case Detective Carter was never able to close.

episodes.name: Asylum
episodes.overview: Reese and Fusco get caught in the war between the two newest POIs, rival crime bosses Elias and Dominic. Also, a tantalizing clue to Shaw’s whereabouts leads Finch and Root into a possible trap, and Control goes rogue to uncover the true intentions of the Samaritan program.

episodes.name: YHWH
episodes.overview: Finch and Root race to save The Machine, which has been located by the rival AI, Samaritan. Also, Reese is caught in the middle of the final showdown between rival crime bosses Elias and Dominic.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: For years, the Person of Interest team have been protected by The Machine, but as worlds collided and a rival AI known as Samaritan finally cornered The Machine inside the nation’s power grid, it was the POI team’s turn to protect Finch’s creation. In season five, the cold war is over. The world around us might look the same, but something has drastically changed. Samaritan’s lethal “correction” has initiated its control. Finch’s Machine is essentially dead. Shaw is still missing. And the team is once again hiding in plain sight. But with Samaritan’s invisible grip tightening everywhere, will Finch be able to rebuild and resurrect The Machine? And if he does, will it be the same Machine when it comes back online?

episodes.name: B.S.O.D.
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch attempt to rescue the Machine’s source code before it deteriorates beyond repair. Also, Root fights for her life against an onslaught of Samaritan’s agents and Fusco is faced with hard questions following the deaths of Dominic and Elias.

episodes.name: SNAFU
episodes.overview: The Machine experiences a glitch during rebooting, supplying Reese and Fusco with the numbers of dozens of people not actually involved in crimes, while also locking Finch and Root out after identifying them as threats based on past violent behavior.

episodes.name: Truth Be Told
episodes.overview: Reese’s cover could be blown when he realizes the latest POI has ties to his old CIA colleague, Kara Stanton.
Shaw escapes her captors, but the team is unsure of her mental state when she begins to act paranoid and reckless.

episodes.name: ShotSeeker
episodes.overview: Reese protects an NYPD analyst whose investigation into a software glitch has drawn the attention of Samaritan. Also, Reese and Fusco are threatened by an ally of Elias’s, who is looking to avenge his friend’s death.

episodes.name: A More Perfect Union
episodes.overview: The Machine sends Reese and Finch to a wedding to protect a pair of POIs before their nuptials. Also, Fusco becomes angry at being kept in the dark by the team and takes it upon himself to investigate a string of missing person reports.

episodes.name: QSO
episodes.overview: Root goes undercover at a radio station to protect the host of a conspiracy theory show who stumbles upon information that could get him killed. Also, Samaritan’s agents try to convince a member of the team that their goals are noble.

episodes.name: Reassortment
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch become trapped in a hospital that becomes ground zero for a deadly viral outbreak. Also, Samaritan’s newest recruit has second thoughts and Shaw continues to struggle with reality.

episodes.name: Sotto Voce
episodes.overview: The mysterious criminal mastermind known as “The Voice” returns and traps Reese and Fusco in their own precinct with several armed gang members and the latest POI. Also, Root makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.name: The Day the World Went Away
episodes.overview: Finch’s number comes up when a fatal error blows his cover identity and sets off a deadly series of escalating encounters with Samaritan’s operatives.

episodes.name: Synecdoche
episodes.overview: The team must unravel a conspiracy and stay ahead of the Secret Service when the President of the United States becomes their newest POI. Also, Finch separates himself from the team and considers taking drastic action to combat Samaritan.

episodes.name: .exe
episodes.overview: As Reese and Shaw race to catch up with Finch, he infiltrates a maximum-security government facility in a desperate mission which could mean the end for not only Samaritan, but for himself and The Machine as well.

episodes.name: return 0
episodes.overview: Finch, Reese, Fusco and Shaw embark on one last mission to prevent Samaritan from destroying The Machine and cementing its hold over mankind.

shows.name: Pluribus
shows.overview: The most miserable person on Earth must save the world from happiness.

episodes.name: We Is Us
episodes.overview: An astronomer's discovery turns the planet upside down. Carol Sturka, a curmudgeonly novelist, is terrified by this strange new world.

episodes.name: Pirate Lady
episodes.overview: A curiously familiar face introduces Carol to the bizarre new normal. A gathering in Europe brings strangers together...and causes friction.

episodes.name: Grenade
episodes.overview: The World just wants to help—which infuriates Carol. A heart-to-heart conversation ends with a bang.

episodes.name: Please, Carol
episodes.overview: Carol tests the boundaries of this weirdly honest world at the expense of her ego. Far away, a resolute individual learns he's not alone.

episodes.name: Got Milk
episodes.overview: Carol doubles down on her investigation—loneliness be damned. Meanwhile, howls in the night reveal a new source of danger.

episodes.name: HDP
episodes.overview: Carol shares a horrific discovery and learns new truths in the process. Mr. Diabaté lives life to the fullest in Sin City.

episodes.name: The Gap
episodes.overview: Manousos begins a dangerous trek to meet Carol. Returning home from Las Vegas, Carol gets creative with her rebellion.

episodes.name: Charm Offensive
episodes.overview: Carol takes a different tack with The Others and discovers more than she anticipated. Manousos awakens in unfamiliar surroundings.

shows.name: Power Book IV: Force
shows.overview: Tommy Egan leaves New York behind and plans to take on Chicago, using his outsider status to break all the local rules and rewrite them on his quest to become the biggest drug dealer in the city.

episodes.name: A Short Fuse and a Long Memory
episodes.overview: On his journey to LA, Tommy stops in Chicago, only to discover shocking news about his family. Tommy must decide whether he is going to force his skeletons back in the closet, or put down roots in the Windy City.

episodes.name: King of the Goddamn Hill
episodes.overview: When JP receives an unexpected warning, Tommy comes to his aide. Determined to lend a helping hand, Tommy approaches a local dealer proposing a business arrangement, but their introduction takes a turn for the worse.

episodes.name: Fire Starter
episodes.overview: Tommy finds himself face-to-face with a ghost from his past. The reunion unearths a discovery when Tommy stumbles across hidden product. Tommy brokers a sit-down between rivals and learns the true nature of the feud.

episodes.name: Storm Clouds
episodes.overview: Tommy's former foe turned friend is at the mercy of a notorious criminal organization who resurface to reclaim what's theirs. The group is led by an enemy from Tommy's life back in New York who is still out for blood.

episodes.name: Take Me Home
episodes.overview: Tommy is offered a profitable solution, from an unlikely source, that may be the answer to his troubles. Intrigued, Tommy is informed he must first address a problem threatening the new venture before it begins.

episodes.name: This Is Who We Are
episodes.overview: Tommy and his new business partner recruit soldiers to take over the drug game in Chicago. Tommy finds a lucrative location for distribution that doesn't fit with his partner's vision for a more upscale clientele.

episodes.name: Outrunning a Ghost
episodes.overview: Tommy's new product is spreading like wildfire across Chicago. The current success isn't good enough for Tommy. He wants to own the entire city and is determined to figure out how to do so, no matter the cost.

episodes.name: He Ain't Heavy
episodes.overview: Tommy and his crew can barely keep up with the demand and they need more help to increase their supply. More shocking details about Tommy's family surface, and he realizes the news could potentially affect his business.

episodes.name: Trust
episodes.overview: Vic faces a devastating loss. Walter is ready to go to war and sends for heavy hitters. Tommy soon realizes he needs more power but is turned down by one of his closest allies and is forced to turn to an unlikely resource.

episodes.name: Family Business
episodes.overview: Decisions are made by those closest to Tommy which could leave him powerless. When the gangs face off, truths come to light, shifting the power of the drug game. This battle may be over, but the war is far from won.

episodes.name: TOMMY'S BACK
episodes.overview: Tommy and Diamond hustle to keep CBI's game ahead of Jenard's new faction in the streets, while Tommy makes solo moves to avenge Liliana's death. All the while, Tommy hasn't forgotten his ultimate goal to become a kingpin.

episodes.name: GREAT CONSEQUENCE
episodes.overview: Jenard’s crew seeks revenge as Tommy learns of a rivalry between Miguel and the Serbs that he and Diamond leverage to CBI’s advantage. Meanwhile, the Feds pursue a task force with Tommy at the center of the investigation.

episodes.name: WAR & ICE CREAM
episodes.overview: Tommy and Diamond expand their business to prisons, the Feds put together a task force to take down CBI, and Jenard struggles to maintain control. Tommy faces off with Walter and gets closer to avenging Liliana's death.

episodes.name: THE DEVIL'S IN THE DETAILS
episodes.overview: Tommy and Diamond keep dangerous secrets from each other, Jenard clashes with his crew, and Vic teams up with Claudia one last time. D-Mac ends up entangled deeper in the drug game than he ever intended.

episodes.name: CROWN VIC
episodes.overview: Heightened police presence threatens Tommy and Diamond's bottom line and they form a coalition with a rival gang. Jenard hits rock bottom, and the Flynn family loyalties are tested with devastating results.

episodes.name: HERE THERE BE MONSTERS
episodes.overview: Tommy and Diamond expand their coalition by bringing Vic and Jenard into CBI. Mirković warns Tommy against encroaching on Serb territory, and makes good on his threat with catastrophic results.

episodes.name: CHICAGO IS HEATING UP!
episodes.overview: Tommy and Diamond continue gaining territory behind Miguel’s back, but Diamond is pulled in other directions. Jenard gets more than he bargained for. Tommy puts Vic’s loyalty to the test.

episodes.name: DEAD RECKONING
episodes.overview: Tommy makes bold moves to connect CBI directly with the cartel as he hustles to stay ahead of the many adversaries out for his blood. Diamond is forced to make a decision that has dire consequences.

episodes.name: NO LOOSE ENDS
episodes.overview: Tommy and Diamond suspect a snitch and put their inner circle to the test. Mireya gives Tommy a key piece of information. The war between Miguel and Mirkovic comes to a head.

episodes.name: POWER POWDER RESPECT
episodes.overview: Tommy orchestrates the grand finale of his long game to take over Chicago’s drug world. When he is faced with devastating personal sacrifices, he finds that he might just lose more than he ever stood to gain.

episodes.name: Do or Die
episodes.overview: With some of his biggest obstacles off the map, Tommy faces new opportunities and challenges in his quest to take over the Chicago drug game.

episodes.name: A Seat at the Table
episodes.overview: Tommy's ambition sets him on a dangerous path, testing his alliances and endangering those close to him.

episodes.name: There's Always a Price to Pay
episodes.overview: As Tommy does damage control with allies, Diamond and Jenard devise a plan to deal with D-Mac, and Vic plots his next move.

episodes.name: Time To See The King
episodes.overview: Tommy finds a way to protect D-Mac, and Jenard mends fences to please Shanti.

episodes.name: The Last Dance
episodes.overview: Diamond and Jenard strengthen their relationship over a common enemy; while Tommy ties up a loose end.

episodes.name: Asset Forfeiture
episodes.overview: Tommy and Diamond disagree on business, while Jenard takes the opportunity to introduce another hustle to CBI; Stacy does damage control to salvage her campaign, and Mireya contemplates her future.

episodes.name: Lines in the Sand
episodes.overview: While some relationships are mended, other brewing tensions reach their boiling point, setting the stage for unlikely allies.

shows.name: Pretty Little Liars: Original Sin
shows.overview: Twenty years ago, a series of tragic events almost ripped the blue-collar town of Millwood apart. Now, in the present day, a group of disparate teen girls finds themselves tormented by an unknown Assailant and made to pay for the secret sin their parents committed two decades ago, as well as their own.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In 1999, tragic events threatened to rip apart a close-knit circle of friends and the small town of Millwood. Twenty years later, a new group of Millwood High students is hunted by an assailant known as "A," who threatens to make them pay for their parents' past transgressions and sins of their own.

episodes.name: Chapter One: Spirit Week
episodes.overview: In 1999, a group of friends is rocked by the sudden death of one of their own. Twenty-two years later, their daughters are pushed together by a mysterious foe.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Spirit Queen
episodes.overview: As Imogen and her newfound friends plot revenge against a mutual nemesis, Karen and her twin sister Kelly hatch an insidious plan of their own.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: Aftermath
episodes.overview: In the wake of Spirit Week, Imogen unearths long-buried truths on her path to unmask the mysterious “A.” After Sheriff Beasley closes in, Noa, Faran, and Mouse weigh their options, while Tabby works to recover vital evidence.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: The (Fe)male Gaze
episodes.overview: After their punishment comes to an end, the girls cement their friendship when Imogen needs them most.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Night He Came Home
episodes.overview: Desperate to keep her mother’s house, Imogen throws a Halloween party to raise cash.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: Scars
episodes.overview: As Imogen and Tabby dig into the mystery surrounding Angela Waters, Faran deals with the scars of her past. After Shawn confronts Marjorie, Noa questions her relationship with her mother, while Mouse spots a familiar face on her first date.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: Carnival of Souls
episodes.overview: As the Millwood carnival approaches, Mouse and Tabby each struggle with secrets, and Noa notices Shawn isn’t himself. Meanwhile, Imogen considers her baby’s future, and Faran confronts everything that’s been plaguing her.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: Bad Blood
episodes.overview: The friends work together to uncover Imogen and Tabby’s assailant during the Annual Thanksgiving Millwood High Blood Drive. Later, Sidney confronts Tabby about her secrets.

episodes.name: Chapter Nine: Dead and Buried
episodes.overview: Despite coming clean about “A,” the friends find their troubles are far from over – especially as the results of the group’s clandestine blood drive push Tabby towards a new suspect.

episodes.name: Chapter Ten: Final Girls
episodes.overview: As “A” doubles down, the friends must work quickly to uncover the link between Angela Waters’ death, their mothers, and their mysterious foe… before it’s too late.

seasons.name: Summer School
seasons.overview: In Season 2, our PLLs face down summer school and a new villain — who may or may not have a connection to "A" — ready to put them all to the test.

episodes.name: Chapter Eleven: Spookyspaghetti.com
episodes.overview: The PLLs await the results of A's trial and a much-needed break – only to be cursed with a fate worse than death ... summer school.

episodes.name: Chapter Twelve: Summer Lovin
episodes.overview: Heeding Dr. Sullivan's advice, the PLLs make the most of their summers. Meanwhile, Imogen forges a new identity away from her closest friends.

episodes.name: Chapter Thirteen: Sweet Sixteen
episodes.overview: As the PLLs plan Mouse's surprise sixteenth birthday party, Tabby and Imogen face boy problems, Noa clashes with Jen and Faran spills her secret.

episodes.name: Chapter Fourteen: When a Stranger Calls Back
episodes.overview: Still shaken from her encounter with Bloody Rose, Mouse searches for the real Rose Waters. Meanwhile, Imogen keeps tabs on Dr. Sullivan, Tabby works on a new short, Noa takes a much-needed day off, and Faran’s strength is put to the ultimate test.

episodes.name: Chapter Fifteen: Friday the 13th
episodes.overview: A disturbing discovery causes the PLLs to doubt Dr. Sullivan. Meanwhile, during Tabby's movie marathon, Noa is forced to make a brutal decision.

episodes.name: Chapter Sixteen: Hell House
episodes.overview: After discovering that Kelly's church is using her former home for their disturbing "Hell House", Imogen springs into action, while Mouse and Ash plan a Pride pool party in protest. Later, the PLLs' plan to freak out the faithful takes a frightening turn.

episodes.name: Chapter Seventeen: The Bogeyman
episodes.overview: Still shaken from Hell House, Imogen learns about Dr. Sullivan's secret ties to A, while the PLLs set out to uncover Bloody Rose's identity.

episodes.name: Chapter Eighteen: Final Exam
episodes.overview: The PLLs take a final stab at their list of suspects, and through a harrowing night will discover the identity of Bloody Rose Waters once and for all.

shows.name: Prime Target
shows.overview: A brilliant math student is on the verge of a major breakthrough when a shadowy enemy tries to stop him. Fighting for answers—and his life—he teams up with a government agent to unravel a high-stakes conspiracy.

episodes.name: A New Pattern
episodes.overview: Cambridge student Edward Brooks starts working on a secret research project that triggers unthinkable chaos.

episodes.name: Syracuse
episodes.overview: Ed's work catches the attention of NSA operative Taylah Sanders and a mysterious institute.

episodes.name: The Sequence
episodes.overview: While retracing Safiya's steps, Ed uncovers chilling pleas from the past. Taylah tries to earn Ed's trust.

episodes.name: Kaplar
episodes.overview: Ed digs deeper for clues at the institute. Andrea navigates devastating news in Baghdad. Taylah reconnects with leadership.

episodes.name: House of Wisdom
episodes.overview: Ed and Taylah join Andrea in Baghdad, where they unearth ancient, buried answers—and get caught in the crosshairs of an unknown enemy.

episodes.name: The Last Link
episodes.overview: As the NSA trails their every move, Taylah and Ed race to track down the final piece of the puzzle.

episodes.name: Prime Finder
episodes.overview: Ed is coerced into completing his work. Taylah considers an ultimatum. An ally gets trapped in the middle of the mayhem.

episodes.name: The Key
episodes.overview: As Ed and Taylah try to expose the truth, a deadly threat is discovered to be closer than they could have imagined.

shows.name: Queer Eye
shows.overview: An all-new “Fab Five” advise men on fashion, grooming, food, culture and design in this modern reboot of the Emmy Award-winning reality series.

episodes.name: Yass, Australia!
episodes.overview: The Fab Five give some love to the town of Yass, Australia. After taking the town by storm, they makeover George, a hard-working local farmer, and give back to the community with a makeover of the local pub.

episodes.name: Where There’s a Will...
episodes.overview: William Holmes is in a state of paralysis by analysis and extreme budgeting due to crushing student loan debt. He thinks a real life can only begin when he’s debt-free. The Fab 5 teach him that you can plan for the future and how to live for today!

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: An all-new “Fab Five” advise men on fashion, grooming, food, culture and design in this modern reboot of the Emmy Award-winning reality series.

episodes.name: You Can't Fix Ugly
episodes.overview: A lonely dump-truck driver with a big ol' heart goes from "ugly" to unbelievable and learns how to reverse years of bad habits.

episodes.name: Saving Sasquatch
episodes.overview: He's drowning in dog hair and prefers to keep his friends at a distance. But this self-depreciating app builder is finally ready to let folks in.

episodes.name: Dega Don't
episodes.overview: A NASCAR enthusiast and former Marine known for his wild parties and crazy costumes makes an effort to dress up and connect with his family.

episodes.name: To Gay or Not Too Gay
episodes.overview: An emotional makeover helps the self-proclaimed "Straightest Gay Guy in Atlanta" come out to his stepmother and make peace with his past.

episodes.name: Camp Rules
episodes.overview: The Fab Five pull off a miracle with a devoutly Christian father of six by redesigning his tiny home and giving his bride the reception she never had.

episodes.name: The Renaissance of Remington
episodes.overview: After inheriting his grandmother's home – and her dated decor – a young entrepreneur digs his way out of a time warp to find his own style.

episodes.name: Below Average Joe
episodes.overview: A subdued stand-up comic who lacks self-confidence after a major weight loss is swimming in big, baggy clothes. And he still lives with his parents.

episodes.name: Hose Before Bros
episodes.overview: A selfless firefighter jumps at the chance to revamp his image and give his fire station a sleek, new look just in time for a community fundraiser.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The Fab Five are back for another season with more hip tips, emotionally charged makeovers and heartfelt reveals that bring out all the feels.

episodes.name: God Bless Gay
episodes.overview: A devoutly religious woman with a gay son and a giving heart gets a new look – and a makeover for her church's new community center.

episodes.name: A Decent Proposal
episodes.overview: A scraggly film buff reboots his life – and his non-existent grooming habits – to give his girlfriend an award-worthy marriage proposal.

episodes.name: Unleash the Sexy Beast
episodes.overview: A married bartender and father of two who lives like a messy bachelor needs to pull it together in time for a parent-teacher mixer.

episodes.name: The Handyman Can
episodes.overview: A free-spirited Mr. Fix-It who lives for Burning Man makes big changes to prepare for a cross-country move. But his best friend doesn't want him to go.

episodes.name: Sky's the Limit
episodes.overview: The Fab Five help a transgender man who's recovering from top surgery throw a party to thank his friends who've shown unconditional love and support.

episodes.name: Big Little Lies
episodes.overview: A jobless couch potato who can't stop lying is forced to start fresh and tell his mom the truth: that he didn't actually graduate from college.

episodes.name: Bedazzled
episodes.overview: He's a singer-songwriter and pianist whose only 18. But he dresses like he's decades older, thanks to a godmother who's done everything for him.

episodes.name: Make Ted Great Again
episodes.overview: The "hipster mayor" of a small town has really big plans. But first he needs to upgrade his look so that others will start taking him seriously.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The Fab Five hit the road and head to Kansas City, Missouri, for another season of feel-good fun and emotional makeovers.

episodes.name: From Hunter to Huntee
episodes.overview: She can hunt, fish and grow her own food. But this self-sufficient woman needs help when it comes to crafting a look that's both womanly and powerful.

episodes.name: Lost Boy
episodes.overview: The Fab Five go back to camp to help a scraggly outdoorsman put down roots and create a cool home for his teenage son.

episodes.name: Jones Bar-B-Q
episodes.overview: They've built a business on slow-cooked barbecue – and a secret sauce. Now these hardworking sisters are finally getting the break they deserve.

episodes.name: When Robert Met Jamie
episodes.overview: With his wedding just days away, a self-deprecating groom must learn to love himself before he's ready to walk down the aisle.

episodes.name: Black Girl Magic
episodes.overview: A young lesbian struggling with her identity opens her heart to let people in, only to discover she's much stronger than she realized.

episodes.name: Elrod & Sons
episodes.overview: A still-grieving single father whose wife died of cancer vows to honor her memory by moving forward with their two young sons.

episodes.name: Sloth to Slay
episodes.overview: A sweet but shy gamer who's spent his life in front of a screen finds the courage to make new friends and find his tribe.

episodes.name: Baby on Board
episodes.overview: Asking for help is hard for this serial procrastinator. But with his house in disarray – and a baby on the way – it's time to step up.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The Fab Five are back in Kansas City, Missouri! Join Antoni, Bobby, Jonathan, Karamo and Tan for even more inspiring makeovers and big emotions.

episodes.name: Without Further Ado
episodes.overview: Jonathan returns to his hometown to make over his high school music teacher, a selfless educator whose fiery red mullet hasn't changed in 30 years.

episodes.name: Disabled but Not Really
episodes.overview: A former bad boy who turned his life around after becoming paralyzed gets a wheelchair-accessible home and a new image to match his positive outlook.

episodes.name: Stoner Skates By
episodes.overview: His 10-year-old daughter calls him a "man child." But can this larger-than-life single dad grow up and become the adult she needs him to be?

episodes.name: How Wanda Got Her Groove Back
episodes.overview: A demanding drill-team leader who's set in her ways learns to shed her tough skin, soften her style – and open up to her two grown daughters.

episodes.name: On Golden Kenny
episodes.overview: The Fab Five help a kind but lonely bachelor find unconditional love and get his dusty home ready for visitors, the first guests he's had in years.

episodes.name: A Tale of Two Cultures
episodes.overview: A proud Chicana woman and arts advocate trades her dated locks for a polished look that gives her the confidence to talk publicly about her passions.

episodes.name: Soldier Returns Home
episodes.overview: A scruffy ex-soldier who builds houses for homeless veterans spruces to reconnect with his wife and finds unexpected strength in vulnerability.

episodes.name: Farm to Able
episodes.overview: A recently divorced farmer who's weathered hard times makes room for self-care and turns his barn back into a chic farm-to-table dining space.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: The Fab Five head to historic Philadelphia to make over a new cast of everyday heroes, from a hardworking DJ to a struggling dog groomer.

episodes.name: Preaching Out Loud
episodes.overview: The Fab Five help a timid gay pastor who came out in his 30s update his look and find the confidence to lead his congregation into the future.

episodes.name: Groomer Has It
episodes.overview: To get her stalled mobile dog grooming business back in gear, a scrappy entrepreneur must polish her brand – and add some swag to her own wag.

episodes.name: Father of the Bride
episodes.overview: A divorced dad who hides behind baggy clothes and crusty hair gel gets a dazzling makeover – and learns to dance – for his daughter's wedding day.

episodes.name: The North Philadelphia Story
episodes.overview: He's a humble hero who's survived homelessness – and helped young writers in his community hone their voices. Now he's ready for his next chapter.

episodes.name: The Anxious Activist
episodes.overview: A passionate Gen Z activist is so focused on saving the planet that she forgets to schedule self-care. Can the Fab Five help her find her balance?

episodes.name: DJ's on Repeat
episodes.overview: On a detour to the Jersey Shore, the Fab Five meet a single DJ who's ready to remaster his life and stop comparing himself to his married siblings.

episodes.name: Silver Lining Sweeney
episodes.overview: A devoted supermom worried about her husband's health slows down to make time for herself as she prepares to send her youngest off to college.

episodes.name: Father Knows Fish
episodes.overview: A week off with the Fab Five reminds a tireless fishmonger that his dreams of opening up a restaurant don't have to come between him and his family.

episodes.name: Paging Dr. Yi
episodes.overview: A working mom yearns to balance her home life and career as a pediatrician, but her look screams "medical student." Time for some style tips stat.

episodes.name: Body Rock or Bust
episodes.overview: His life and his business have seen better days. But this lovable West Philly fitness trainer is finally motivated to whip things back into shape.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: The Fab Five bring love and light to the Lone Star State, where everything’s bigger — from the stars at night to the heartfelt transformations.

episodes.name: Showdown at The Broken Spoke
episodes.overview: A honky-tonk dance instructor known for her Daisy Dukes isn't your typical grandma. Her daughter wants her to rein it in – but change won't be easy.

episodes.name: Angel Gets Her Wings
episodes.overview: A trans powerlifter dominates in the gym but struggles with self confidence in public. Can the Fab Five help her harness her inner strength?

episodes.name: No More Bull
episodes.overview: A rugged rancher grew up fast as one of the youngest Army Ranchers in history. Now he longs for a wife and family, but his habits need serious help.

episodes.name: A Night to Remember
episodes.overview: The Fab Five help a high school prom committee deal with the stress and loss of a difficult year as they plan an outdoor dance during a pandemic.

episodes.name: Craw-Zaddy
episodes.overview: Years after his wife's passing, a quirky restaurant owner is ready for change. But both he and his old school eatery remain trapped in days gone by.

episodes.name: Community Allied
episodes.overview: When the pandemic revealed inequities in her community, a passionate health care professional took action. Now it's her turn to practice self-care.

episodes.name: Snow White of Central Texas
episodes.overview: The overworked founder of a rescue organization for special-needs animals is so busy taking care of others that she doesn't make time for herself.

episodes.name: Gimme Shelter
episodes.overview: A hardworking humanitarian with big dreams and a selfless heart steps up his style to raise money for a state-of-the-art community for the homeless.

episodes.name: A Legend in the Baking
episodes.overview: The gang gets cooking with a funky, eclectic baker who's seen hard times and needs a boost to be the face of her business again. The results are sweet.

episodes.name: The Mis-Inspiration of Reggie Devore
episodes.overview: A gifted rapper lost his passion for making music when a global pandemic put his career on pause. Can the Fab Five help him get his groove back?

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: Join the party with the Fab Five in the city of New Orleans for a new season of inspirational heroes — and beautiful before-and-afters.

episodes.name: Queer Eye for the Lambda Chi
episodes.overview: A kindhearted crew of fraternity brothers go from boys to men as they spruce up their house and sharpen their hosting skills for an important event.

episodes.name: Superfan Steph
episodes.overview: A sports superfan who hides behind hats and logos sets a goal to become a better partner for the woman she loves before they move into their new home.

episodes.name: Speedy for Life
episodes.overview: After a traumatic accident, a young man wants to inspire others but hides his own sadness. Can the Fab Five – and a returning hero – help him open up?

episodes.name: Jenni Seckel's Diary
episodes.overview: The Fab Five help a selfless educator who goes all in for her students and co-workers show herself some love and see that she's more than her job.

episodes.name: Deli Dan is a Dream Man
episodes.overview: A gruff deli owner with a big personality pours all of his energy into his business, but his girlfriend is craving more of his time and attention.

episodes.name: Ms. Mary Quite Contrary
episodes.overview: A hardworking hero who spent years in prison and helps the formerly incarcerated rebuild their lives is ready to move forward and embrace her own future.

episodes.name: Sowing the Seeds
episodes.overview: A pioneering farmer who feeds his community with fresh, healthy food struggles to see his own self-worth. Enter the Fab Five to help grow his confidence.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: The Fab Five return to the city of New Orleans to jazz up the lives of their heroes — one emotional makeover at a time.

episodes.name: Mr. Fantastic!
episodes.overview: A "country mouse" who holes up in his garage needs the Fab Five's help in reviving his relationship with his wife before their 39th wedding anniversary.

episodes.name: Kiss the Sky
episodes.overview: A Kiss superfan devoted to taking care of his brother swaps out his band tees for an edgier wardrobe and begins a new journey of happiness and healing.

episodes.name: The Sweet Life
episodes.overview: Facing a new chapter in her life, a clarinet virtuoso looks to reopen her mother's sweet shop and finds cause to celebrate herself before a big surprise.

episodes.name: Protect the Nest
episodes.overview: The athletics director at the Louisiana School for the Deaf strives to save the football program while learning to pour some energy back into himself.

episodes.name: The Flying Nun
episodes.overview: A former nun-turned-social justice lawyer dips her toe back into the dating pool for the first time in years — and the Fab Five are ready to set her up.

episodes.name: When I Say Sexy, You Say
episodes.overview: Struggling with grief, a chef hopes to move forward in her career and honor her late mother with a special dinner that showcases her Vietnamese cuisine.

episodes.name: She Was a Showgirl
episodes.overview: The Fab Five and a glamorous icon team up to help a retired showgirl-turned-seamstress rediscover her sparkle and make a triumphant return to the stage.

episodes.name: Special Delivery
episodes.overview: A charismatic mother sets out to reconnect with herself, move on from a rocky marriage and retroactively celebrate a milestone birthday in style.

episodes.name: Poof Goes Piff!

episodes.name: Five Gays and a Wedding

episodes.name: Merlin Gets a Makeover

shows.name: Reacher
shows.overview: Jack Reacher, a veteran military police investigator, has just recently entered civilian life. Reacher is a drifter, carrying no phone and the barest of essentials as he travels the country and explores the nation he once served.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Based on "Killing Floor," when retired Military Police Officer Jack Reacher is arrested for a murder he did not commit, he finds himself in the middle of a deadly conspiracy full of dirty cops, shady businessmen and scheming politicians. With nothing but his wits, he must figure out what is happening in Margrave, Georgia.

episodes.name: Welcome to Margrave

episodes.name: First Dance
episodes.overview: When more victims are discovered, Reacher attempts to get answers but is set up. Roscoe receives a threatening message.

episodes.overview: As the danger increases, Reacher and Roscoe grow closer and they make plans to meet with their contact from Homeland Security.

episodes.name: No Apologies
episodes.overview: As the mystery deepens, Reacher teams up with an old colleague and Finlay makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.name: Papier
episodes.overview: As the town is rocked by another murder, Reacher heads to New York and learns the truth about the illegal business in Margrave while Roscoe faces danger in the woods.

episodes.name: Reacher Said Nothing
episodes.overview: Reacher springs a trap and then gets trapped himself.

episodes.name: Pie
episodes.overview: Reacher leads a rescue mission at the warehouse that ends in a showdown.

seasons.name: Season 2

episodes.name: ATM

episodes.name: What Happens in Atlantic City

episodes.name: Picture Says a Thousand Words

episodes.name: A Night at the Symphony
episodes.overview: Reacher and his team head to Boston to track down a political aide with insider knowledge of a top secret military-defense contract that may be the reason behind their friends' deaths.

episodes.name: Burial
episodes.overview: Neagley and Dixon discover shocking information about an old friend in Denver while Reacher and O'Donnell learn more about the nefarious and mysterious A.M..

episodes.name: New York's Finest
episodes.overview: As the mystery continues to unfold, Reacher and his team set a trap to even the score.

episodes.name: The Man Goes Through
episodes.overview: As the team close in on Langston, two members of the 110th face danger, compelling Reacher to devise a dangerous plan to rescue them.

episodes.name: Fly Boy
episodes.overview: Reacher and Neagley make a final desperate attempt to save O’Donnell and Dixon, stop A.M. and avenge their friends’ murder.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Based on "Persuader," Reacher hurtles into the dark heart of a vast criminal enterprise when trying to rescue an undercover DEA informant whose time is running out. There he finds a world of secrecy and violence—and confronts some unfinished business from his own past.

episodes.name: Persuader
episodes.overview: Reacher’s attempt to thwart a kidnapping brings him into contact with mysterious businessman Zachary Beck.

episodes.name: Truckin'
episodes.overview: Tasked with transporting cargo for his new employer Zachary Beck, Reacher must juggle the involvement of the DEA and a nosy new associate.

episodes.name: Number 2 with a Bullet
episodes.overview: As a rising body count threatens his undercover position, Reacher makes a dangerous play to secure Beck’s trust.

episodes.name: Dominique
episodes.overview: Reacher reunites with Duffy and Villanueva and finally shares the painful details of his history with Xavier Quinn.

episodes.name: Smackdown
episodes.overview: When a DEA tragedy puts the entire mission at risk, Reacher, Duffy, and Villanueva improvise a drastic plan to save their cover.

episodes.name: Smoke on the Water
episodes.overview: Reacher is torn between his desire to kill Quinn and his promise to Duffy to save Teresa.

episodes.name: L.A. Story
episodes.overview: After Reacher and Duffy travel to Los Angeles to arrange a deal, Neagley arrives in Maine to help Reacher get answers.

episodes.name: Unfinished Business
episodes.overview: Reacher finally faces off with both Paulie and Quinn.

shows.name: Robin Hood
shows.overview: A modern reimagining of the classic tale. After the Norman invasion of England, Rob, a Saxon forester’s son, and Marian, a Norman lord’s daughter, fall in love and unite to fight for justice, challenge corruption, and restore peace to the land.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In 12th-century England, Robert of Locksley rises from grief to rebellion. With Marian at his side and outlaws at his back, Rob defies the Sheriff of Nottingham and Norman rule. His fight for freedom will give birth to the legend of Robin Hood.

episodes.name: I See Him
episodes.overview: We meet Robert of Locksley, a young Saxon whose world is shattered by injustice. His struggle to right a personal wrong will forge him into something legendary...not just a man, but a symbol.

episodes.name: A Heinous Devil
episodes.overview: After witnessing his father's brutal execution, a young Saxon forester, Robert of Locksley, begins a dangerous descent into vengeance that will ignite a legend.

episodes.name: No Man Can Hide Forever
episodes.overview: The death of Huntingdon's son deepens the rift between Normans and Saxons. Rob gains a powerful ally in Little John, but the Sheriff's pursuit grows, driving the outlaws deeper into Sherwood. Marian enters the dazzling yet perilous court in Westminster.

episodes.name: The Cause of This Unrest
episodes.overview: Rob and his band target the Sheriff's reward money — a bold heist that could change their fortunes, if it doesn't first get them killed.

episodes.name: Go Back to Them
episodes.overview: Rob risks all to save the Millers from hanging. In Westminster, Marian's world tilts with news of her brother's death.

episodes.name: Bound by Love, Divided by Lies
episodes.overview: Queen Eleanor arrives in Nottingham, throwing the Barons, and the Sheriff, into turmoil. Rob and Marian are reunited at last.

episodes.name: Thieves with a Purpose
episodes.overview: Rob acts on his secret pact. Meanwhile, Prince John arrives in Westminster, and Marian is drawn into a dangerous attraction.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Nine contestants were selected to compete in the running of becoming "America's Next Drag Superstar". The winner of the first season won the following prizes: a lifetime supply of MAC Cosmetics, be featured an LA Eyeworks campaign, join the Logo Drag Race tour, and a cash prize of $20,000.

episodes.name: Drag on a Dime
episodes.overview: Nine contestants must re-invent their glam drag looks using thrift store clothing and tschotchkes from the 99-cent store. Guest judge Bob Mackie stops by to help RuPaul weed out the drag queen with the least style.

episodes.overview: Wigs fly when the contestants split up into 2 rival girl groups, something guest judge Michelle Williams of Destiny's Child would know plenty about. Can the girls impress RuPaul with their lip-synching skills?

episodes.name: Drag School of Charm

episodes.name: Absolut Drag Ball
episodes.overview: RuPaul makes the queens hit the floor in a good old fashioned drag ball inspired by Absolut's real fruit flavored vodkas.

episodes.name: Extra Special Edition
episodes.overview: Look back at the highlights, lowlights, and previously unseen footage from the first six episodes as we race toward the climactic grand finale!

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: The last 3 queens face their final challenge while shooting the music video for RuPaul's new single "Cover Girl (Put The Bass In Your Walk)." Out artist Cazwell stops by to help the judges cast their final vote.

episodes.name: Reunited!
episodes.overview: In this reunion special, all nine contestants return to give their take on what happened during the show. Plus, the girls confront the judges...and each other!

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: For season two, the number of contestants was increased from nine to twelve, and the prizes were slightly modified: a lifetime supply of Nyx Cosmetics and be the face of nyxcosmetics.com, an exclusive one year public relations contract with LGBT firm Project Publicity, be featured an LA Eyeworks campaign, join the Logo Drag Race tour, and a cash prize of $25,000.

episodes.name: Gone with the Window
episodes.overview: Twelve new queens compete to be America's Next Drag Superstar! The queens must reinvent their drag looks using only a set of curtains and household items. Guest judges include comedienne Kathy Griffin & photographer Mike Ruiz.

episodes.name: Golden Gals
episodes.overview: The queens must transform a group of silver daddies into their drag mothers in this NYX Cosmetics challenge. They're joined by guest judges Debbie Reynolds & Cloris Leachman as well as NYX Cosmetics founder Toni Ko.

episodes.overview: The final four queens hit the red carpet and pull out all the stops as they create looks for three separate divalicious award shows. Guest judges include Academy Award winner Tatum O'Neal and Tony Award winner Marissa Jaret Winokur.

episodes.overview: A look back on the highlights, low-lights, and previously unseen footage from the first nine episodes as we race toward the climactic grand finale!

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: The last three queens face their final challenge - shooting the music video for RuPaul's next single "Jealous of My Boogie." Guests include reality star Robert Verdi, make-up artist Mathu Anderson and choreographer Ryan Heffington.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.overview: The contestants' tasks include being a newscaster, product spokesperson and talk-show host to RuPaul and guest judge Debra Wilson.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview:
The third season of RuPaul's Drag Race began airing on January 24, 2011. Thirteen drag queens competed for the title of "America's Next Drag Superstar", a headlining spot on the Absolut Tour, a lifetime supply of Kryolan makeup, and a cash prize of $75,000.

This season saw Michelle Visage replacing Merle Ginsberg at the judge's table and Billy B., Mike Ruiz, and Jeffrey Moran filling in for Santino Rice's absence during several episodes.

The claws come out in the first challenge of the season when the girls are asked to create a holiday look with nothing but some tinsel, ornaments and a little well placed mistletoe. Guest Judges: Vanessa Williams / Mike Ruiz

episodes.overview: The race gets sticky and sweet, when the queens compete in a pageant of candy inspired couture.

episodes.name: The Final Three, Hunty
episodes.overview: The top 3 queens go to court, as Judge Ru presents their final challenge - starring in the music video for RuPaul's hit, "The Beginning".

episodes.name: Countdown to the Crown
episodes.overview: A look back on the highlights, low-lights, and previously unseen footage from the season.

episodes.name: Reunited
episodes.overview: Wigs fly as the queens return to discuss the drama of the season.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Just when you thought you knew what to expect from RuPaul’s Drag Race, along comes the ferociously fabulous and funny Season Six, with enough tricks up its silk chiffon sleeve to keep you on your painted toes! This crop of queens is our most diverse yet, from seasoned pros, to an international drag star, to a former American Idol contestant, and even some fresh-faced ingénue queens who were inspired to be drag performers by watching Season One of RuPaul’s Drag Race! That’s one leggy legacy. Have we mentioned that these boys are hot? Because they are. Have we mentioned they make even hotter women? Because they do.

episodes.name: RuPaul's Big Opening, Pt. 1
episodes.overview: Season 6 premieres with 14 new queens competing to become America's Next Drag Superstar. But first they must face a death-defying photoshoot. With guest judge Adam Lambert and photographer Mike Ruiz.

episodes.name: RuPaul's Big Opening, Pt. 2
episodes.overview: The queens are challenged to create party-themed couture for a runway face-off. With guest judge Khloe Kardashian.

episodes.name: Scream Queens
episodes.overview: The queens put the "fear" in "fierce" as they act in a drag horror movie franchise. With guest judges Lena Headey (Game Of Thrones) and Linda Blair (The Exorcist).

episodes.name: Shade: The Rusical
episodes.overview: The queens enter the world of musical theater. With guest judges composer Lucian Piane, and Sheryl Lee Ralph (Dream Girls).

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens impersonate celebrities in a quick-witted TV game show. With guest judges Gillian Jacobs (Community) and Heather McDonald (Chelsea Lately).

episodes.name: Oh No She Betta Don't
episodes.overview: The queens are challenged to rap in a TLC-inspired 90s music video. Rap superstars Eve and Trina guest judge.

episodes.name: Glamazon By Colorevolution
episodes.overview: The queens book a big cosmetics gig, selling RuPaul's new makeup line. With guest judges Leah Remini (The King of Queens) and Lainie Kazan (My Big Fat Greek Wedding).

episodes.name: Drag Queens of Comedy
episodes.overview: The queens must write and perform a stand-up comedy routine in front of a live audience. With guest judges Jaime Pressly (My Name Is Earl) and comedy writer Bruce Vilanch.

episodes.name: Queens of Talk
episodes.overview: The queens host their very own talk show. With guest judges Paula Abdul, Chaz Bono, and singer (and Cher's mom) Georgia Holt.

episodes.name: Drag My Wedding
episodes.overview: The queens give blushing brides drag makeovers, before RuPaul officiates their weddings. With guest judges Neil Patrick Harris (How I Met Your Mother) and his fiancé David Burtka.

episodes.name: Glitter Ball
episodes.overview: The queens compete in a pageant of jewelry inspired couture. Guest judges Khloe Kardashian and legendary designer Bob Mackie return.

episodes.name: Sissy That Walk
episodes.overview: The queens compete in their final challenge - starring in the music video for RuPaul's hit "Sissy That Walk." With special guests Jamal Sims and Mathu Andersen.

episodes.name: Countdown To The Crown
episodes.overview: A look back on the highlights, low-lights, and previously unseen footage as we race toward the climactic crowning of America's Next Drag Superstar.

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: Wigs fly as the queens return to discuss the drama of the season. Plus, both "America's Next Drag Superstar" and "Miss Congeniality" are crowned.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: ​​​RuPaul's Drag Race returns with a court of queens so ingenious, a competition so unpredictable and a judges' panel so packed with talent, you'll be seeing stars It's all the artistry, all the humanity and all the head-turning twists you love but if you think you know this Race, honey, you have no idea.​​

episodes.name: Born Naked
episodes.overview: Season 7 premieres with 14 new queens competing to become America's Next Drag Superstar. But first they must face their worst fear: a naked runway! With guest judge Kathy Griffin, new permanent judges Carson Kressley and Ross Mathews.

episodes.name: Glamazonian Airways
episodes.overview: The queens are challenged to produce a pre-flight safety video for the first airline run by drag queens. With guest judges Olivia Newton-John and Jordin Sparks.

episodes.name: ShakesQueer
episodes.overview: The queens "Hamlet it up" in two twisted Shakespeare classics. With guest judges Kat Dennings (2 Broke Girls) and Spice Girl Mel B.

episodes.name: Spoof! (There It Is)
episodes.overview: The queens have to sing in parody music videos. With guest judges Jessica Alba (Sin City) and RuPaul's music producer Lucian Piane.

episodes.name: The DESPY Awards
episodes.overview: The queens' comedy skills are tested as they act as presenters at a glitzy awards show. With comedian Kathy Griffin and fashion icon Isaac Mizrahi.

episodes.name: Ru Hollywood Stories
episodes.overview: The queens star in a mystery behind-the-scenes reenactment series. Pop sensation Ariana Grande and former Drag Race panelist Merle Ginsberg guest judge.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens impersonate celebrities in a bawdy quick-witted TV game show. With guest judges Tamar Braxton (Tamar & Vince) and Michael Urie (Ugly Betty).

episodes.name: Conjoined Queens
episodes.overview: The queens pair up to give each other conjoined drag-twin makeovers. With guest judges LeAnn Rimes and Nelsan Ellis (True Blood's Lafayette).

episodes.name: Divine Inspiration
episodes.overview: The queens perform in musical versions of cult director John Waters' most iconic films. With guest judges Demi Lovato and John Waters.

episodes.name: Prancing Queens
episodes.overview: The queens are challenged to perform a choreographed routine in a live drag dance spectacular. With guest judges Alyssa Milano (Charmed) and comedian Rachael Harris (The Hangover).

episodes.name: Hello, Kitty Girls!
episodes.overview: The queens compete in a pageant of Hello Kitty inspired couture. Rebecca Romijn (X-Men) and former Drag Race panelist Santino Rice guest judge.

episodes.name: And the Rest Is a Drag
episodes.overview: The queens compete in their final challenge - starring in the music video for RuPaul's hit "Born Naked." Michelle Visage, Carson Kressley and Ross Mathews judge.

episodes.name: Countdown to the Crown
episodes.overview: A look back on the highlights, low-lights, and previously unseen footage as we race toward the climactic crowning of America's Next Drag Superstar.

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: Tensions run high as the queens return to discuss the drama of the season; both America's Next Drag Superstar and Miss Congeniality are crowned.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: RuPaul is back to light up the runway with 12 new queens competing for the title of "American's Next Drag Superstar." Season 8 marks a drag milestone: the 100th episode and the 100th queen! Watch as these talented ladies of drag join the ranks of the fabulous 88 queens who fought for the crown before them. The 12 Queens to compete include: Acid Betty, Bob the Drag Queen, Chi Chi DeVayne, Cynthia Lee Fontaine, Dax ExclamationPoint, Derrick Barry, Kim Chi, Laila McQueen, Naomi Smalls, Nayasha Lopez, Robbie Turner, and Thorgy Thor.

episodes.name: Keeping It 100!
episodes.overview: Season 8 premieres with the 100th episode of Drag Race, and the 100th queen competing to become America's Next Drag Superstar. The first test is to create an outfit from a legendary design challenge from a past season. With guest judge Nicole Richie.

episodes.name: Bitch Perfect
episodes.overview: The queens are challenged to perform in a collegiate, all-queen drag-appella sing-off. With guest judges Ester Dean (Pitch Perfect, Pitch Perfect 2), choreographer Jamal Sims and RuPaul's music producer Lucian Piane.

episodes.name: RuCo's Empire
episodes.overview: The queens get their Cookie on in two Empire-inspired scenes. With guest judges Tasha Smith (Empire) and singer-songwriter Faith Evans.

episodes.name: New Wave Queens
episodes.overview: The queens have to sing live in ‘80s style New Wave girl bands. Blondie's Debbie Harry and Chris Stein guest judge, plus RuPaul's music producer Lucian Piane.

episodes.name: Supermodel Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens impersonate celebrities in a quick-witted TV game show, and dress in iconic Madonna looks for the runway. With supermodel guest judges Gigi Hadid and Chanel Iman.

episodes.name: Wizards of Drag
episodes.overview: The queens give cast members of Little Women: LA drag makeovers in the style of The Wizard of Oz. Fashion designer Marc Jacobs and singer-songwriter Todrick Hall guest judge.

episodes.name: Shady Politics
episodes.overview: The queens shoot shady presidential campaign ads, throwing their wigs in the ring to become the first drag president of the USA. Vivica A. Fox (Independence Day: Resurgence) and MSNBC Live news anchor Thomas Roberts guest judge.

episodes.name: RuPaul Book Ball
episodes.overview: The queens compete in a pageant of book inspired couture, and perform a musical tribute to Jerri Blank from Strangers With Candy. Siblings Amy Sedaris and David Sedaris guest judge.

episodes.name: The Realness
episodes.overview: The queens compete in their final challenge - starring in the music video for RuPaul's hit "The Realness." Michelle Visage, Carson Kressley and Ross Mathews judge.

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: Tensions run high as the queens return to discuss the drama of the season. Plus, both "America's Next Drag Superstar" and "Miss Congeniality" are crowned.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: Season Nine’s drag queens are fiercer than ever, competing to snatch the coveted title of "America's Next Drag Superstar." This year’s cutthroat race to the crown features unpredictable competition, gag-worthy performances, and jaw-dropping moments.

episodes.name: Oh. My. Gaga!
episodes.overview: Lady Gaga drops by to meet the 13 new queens competing to become America's Next Drag Superstar. Their first test is to compete in the Miss Charisma Uniqueness Nerve and Talent pageant.

episodes.name: She Done Already Done Brought It On
episodes.overview: Lisa Kudrow from Friends stops by, and the queens are challenged to perform in an epic cheer battle. With guest judges The B-52s.

episodes.name: Draggily Ever After
episodes.overview: The queens must create fairytale drag princesses, and transform themselves into sassy sidekicks. With guest judges Todrick Hall and Cheyenne Jackson (American Horror Story).

episodes.name: Good Morning Bitches
episodes.overview: The queens join the cutthroat Morning Talk Show wars. Naya Rivera (Glee) and Jeffrey Bowyer-Chapman (UnREAL) guest judge.

episodes.name: Reality Stars: The Musical
episodes.overview: Todrick Hall directs the queens in Broadway's newest mega-sensation, a Reality Stars musical. Singer Meghan Trainor guest judges.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens impersonate celebrities in a quick-witted TV game show. With guest judges Candis Cayne and Denis O’Hare (American Horror Story).

episodes.name: 9021-HO
episodes.overview: The queens act in a classic 90s high school drama, directed by original Beverly Hills 90210 stars Tori Spelling and Jennie Garth.
