episodes.name: RuPaul Roast
episodes.overview: The queens perform a comedy roast of RuPaul in front of a live audience. Singer Tamar Braxton and Fortune Feimster (The Mindy Project) guest judge.

episodes.name: Your Pilot's On Fire
episodes.overview: The queens create, write and star in their own TV pilots. Noah Galvin (The Real O’Neals) and QVC queen Lisa Robertson guest judge.

episodes.name: Makeovers: Crew Better Work
episodes.overview: The queens makeover members of the Drag Race crew. Singer Kesha and RuPaul’s gown designer Zaldy guest judge.

episodes.name: Gayest Ball Ever
episodes.overview: The queens compete in a queer culture pageant, and design outfits inspired by the Village People. Actress Andie MacDowell (Groundhog Day) and supermodel Joan Smalls guest judge.

episodes.name: Category Is
episodes.overview: The queens must write and perform a rap on RuPaul’s new hit single, and guest on RuPaul’s podcast with Michelle Visage. Style superstar Carson Kressley and the hilarious Ross Mathews guest judge.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.overview: As this drag race comes to an end the queens get together to take a look back at who slayed the competition and who deserved to sashey away.

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: In an epic, show-stopping finale, RuPaul crowns America’s Next Drag Superstar.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: The tenth season of RuPaul's Drag Race began airing on March 22, 2018, on VH1. The premiere was broadcast one week after the finale of the third season of RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars, and episodes are to be followed by RuPaul's Drag Race: Untucked.

episodes.name: 10s Across The Board
episodes.overview: Christina Aguilera stunts on the mainstage. Plus, fan favorite queens from the past decade of Drag Race return as 14 new queens compete to become America’s Next Drag Superstar and win $100,000.

episodes.name: PharmaRusical
episodes.overview: The queens must wow the judges (including Halsey and Padma Lakshmi) in a lip-synced dance number inspired by pharmaceutical TV ads, and Andy Cohen and Alyssa Edwards drop by.

episodes.name: Tap That App
episodes.overview: The queens create and star in commercials for new drag-themed dating apps, and rock goddess Courtney Love and actor Nico Tortorella guest judge.

episodes.name: The Last Ball on Earth
episodes.overview: The queens cook up global warming-friendly looks for the last ball ever, and actresses Tisha Campbell-Martin and Logan Browning drop by to guest judge.

episodes.name: The Bossy Rossy Show
episodes.overview: The queens' improv skills are put to the test for the new talk show "Bossy Rossy," hosted by Ross Matthews, and country music icon Shania Twain and actress Carrie Preston guest judge.

episodes.name: Drag Con Panel Extravaganza
episodes.overview: The queens have to produce and host their very own DragCon panels on makeup, hair and body, and Kumail Nanjiani and Emily V. Gordon guest judge.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens must impersonate celebrities for the legendary Snatch Game. Audra McDonald and Kate Upton guest judge, and Bianca Del Rio and Alex Trebek are special guests.

episodes.name: The Unauthorized Rusical
episodes.overview: The queens pay tribute to one of the greatest stars of all time in Cher: The Unauthorized Rusical. Andrew Rannells and Billy Eichner guest judge.

episodes.name: Breastworld
episodes.overview: The queens are assigned parts in the new hit series "Breastworld." Broad City stars Ilana Glazer and Abbi Jacobson guest judge, and Randy Rainbow and Stephen Colbert drop by.

episodes.name: Social Media Kings Into Queens
episodes.overview: The queens give some of today's hottest social media superstars drag makeovers. "13 Reasons Why" star Miles Heizer and hip-hop artist Lizzo guest judge.

episodes.name: Evil Twins
episodes.overview: The queens must present two characters on the runway: their best selves and their evil twins. "Girls" creator Lena Dunham and singer Ashanti guest judge, and Cheyenne Jackson ("American Horror Story") is a special guest.

episodes.name: American
episodes.overview: The top four queens must write and perform a verse from RuPaul's hit single "American," and choreographer Todrick Hall, Carson Kressley and Ross Mathews guest judge.

episodes.name: Queens Reunited
episodes.overview: The Season 10 queens return to discuss the most gag-worthy moments, never-before-seen footage, jaw-dropping revelations and the season's most amazing looks.

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: The top four queens get ready to Lip Sync for the Crown in the Season 10 finale.

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: RuPaul's Drag Race and Untucked return with more sickening styles, fierce challenges and backstage drama. Michelle Visage, Carson Kressley, Ross Mathews and celeb guest judges join RuPaul as she sets out to crown America's Next Drag Superstar.

episodes.name: Whatcha Unpackin?
episodes.overview: To kick off Season 11, the contestants direct their own photo shoots with Drag Race alumni and design outfits from past queens' materials, and Miley Cyrus guest judges.

episodes.name: Good God Girl, Get Out
episodes.overview: The queens test their acting chops in parody skits of "Black Panther" and "Get Out," and Bobby Moynihan and Sydelle Noel sit in on the judges' panel.

episodes.name: Diva Worship
episodes.overview: The queens put their knowledge of pop icons to the test in a live, evangelical-style talk show about their favorite divas, and Troye Sivan and Guillermo Diaz guest judge.

episodes.name: Trump: The Rusical
episodes.overview: The queens get political when they're asked to read the news with Rachel Maddow and perform a musical about Donald Trump, and Tiffany Pollard and Joel McHale guest judge.

episodes.name: Monster Ball
episodes.overview: The queens put their design skills to the test as they create three different looks for a spooky, monster-themed ball, and Cara Delevingne and Elvira join the judges' panel.

episodes.name: The Draglympics
episodes.overview: Love Connie leads a quick-drag workout, the queens compete in Draglympic floor routines, and choreographer Travis Wall and Olympians Adam Rippon and Mirai Nagasu guest judge.

episodes.name: From Farm to Runway
episodes.overview: The queens use organic ingredients to create sickening but sustainable looks, Alyssa Edwards choreographs a hoedown, and Amber Valletta and Kandi Burruss guest judge.

episodes.name: Snatch Game At Sea
episodes.overview: Morgan McMichaels and Jinkx Monsoon drop into the werk room, and the queens compete in a nautical-themed version of Snatch Game with guest judges Tony Hale and Clea DuVall.

episodes.name: LADP!
episodes.overview: RuPaul opens the library for some reading, the queens star in a "Cops"-style reality show, and Fortune Feimster, Cheyenne Jackson and Natasha Lyonne join the judges.

episodes.name: Dragracadabra
episodes.overview: Delta Work drops by, the queens get into groups and put on their very own magic shows, and Gina Rodriguez and Katherine Langford sit in with the judges.

episodes.name: Bring Back My Queens!
episodes.overview: The girls make over returning queens to look like members of their own drag families, and Lena Waithe and Wanda Sykes guest judge.

episodes.name: Queens Everywhere
episodes.overview: For their last challenge before the grand finale, the Top 5 queens write lyrics to RuPaul's song "Queens Everywhere," perform a dance number and record a podcast interview.

episodes.name: Reunited
episodes.overview: The Season 11 queens reunite to discuss the Brooke Lynn Hytes-Vanessa Vanjie Mateo romance, Ra'Jah O'Hara's salty comments, and Plastique Tiara's changing stories.

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: In the Season 11 grand finale, Christine and the Queens performs, the Top Four girls compete in an epic lip-sync smackdown, and RuPaul crowns America's next drag superstar.

seasons.name: Season 12
seasons.overview: The twelfth season of RuPaul's Drag Race premiered on February 28 and concluded on May 29, 2020. The competition was broadcast on VH1 in the United States and saw 13 new queens competing for the title of "America's Next Drag Superstar".

episodes.name: I'm That Bitch
episodes.overview: Kicking off Season 12, the first seven queens strut the runway in a fashion show, then rap and perform a choreographed dance in front of guest judge Nicki Minaj.

episodes.name: You Don't Know Me
episodes.overview: In part two of the Season 12 premiere, a new set of queens walks in a fashion show, then performs a Bob Fosse-inspired number in front of guest judges Thandie Newton and Robyn.

episodes.name: World's Worst
episodes.overview: The queens compete on a parody talent show called "World's Worst" and then walk the runway in buttons and bows, and Olivia Munn sits in at the judges' table.

episodes.name: The Ball Ball
episodes.overview: The queens hit the sewing machines to design three different sports-inspired runway lewks for the Ball Ball, and comedian and superfan Leslie Jones sits in with the judges.

episodes.name: Gay’s Anatomy
episodes.overview: The queens put their overacting chops to the test in a "Grey's Anatomy" parody sketch and then walk the runway in cape-forward fashions, and Normani sits in with the judges.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens compete in the legendary Snatch Game. Mean Girls co-stars Jonathan Bennett and Daniel Franzese guest judge. Drag queen Vanessa Vanjie Mateo (Miss Vanjie) makes a guest appearance.

episodes.name: Madonna: The Unauthorized Rusical
episodes.overview: The queens get into the groove in a Queen of Pop inspired musical. U.S. Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and supermodel Winnie Harlow guest judge.

episodes.name: Droop
episodes.overview: The queens must create and market ridiculously extravagant products for the new drag queen lifestyle brand, Droop.

episodes.name: Choices 2020
episodes.overview: It’s time for America’s first drag queen president! The queens argue in a fabulous presidential debate. Actors Jeff Goldblum (Jurassic Park) and Rachel Bloom (Crazy Ex-Girlfriend) guest judge.

episodes.name: Superfan Makeover
episodes.overview: The queens must give makeovers to drag race superfans, who have no idea what's about to happen to them; actor Daisy Ridley guest judges.

episodes.name: One-Queen Show
episodes.overview: The queens must create and perform their own solo show; Whoopi Goldberg coaches the queens.

episodes.name: Viva Drag Vegas
episodes.overview: The queens must perform a medley of songs from RuPaul’s Drag Race Live!, a hit show on the Las Vegas strip. Choreographer Jamal Sims (Disney’s Aladdin) guest judges.

episodes.name: Alone Together
episodes.overview: The 12 queens come together in a virtual slumber party to kiki about all things season 12. Ru checks in with all the girls during quarantine and chats about the shadiest moments, most shocking eliminations and takes fan questions.

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: For the first time in herstory, the Top Three queens compete for the crown virtually in a final, epic lip-sync battle from their homes, featuring celebrity guests and past queens.

seasons.name: Season 13
seasons.overview: The thirteenth season of RuPaul's Drag Race premiered on January 1 and concluded on April 23, 2021. The cast was announced via Twitter on December 9, 2020. The competition is broadcast on VH1 in the United States and showcases 13 new queens competing for the title of "America's Next Drag Superstar".

episodes.name: The Pork Chop
episodes.overview: After making their werk room entrances, the queens face off in a series of Lip Sync for Your Life battles.

episodes.name: Condragulations
episodes.overview: After the first contestant of the season is voted out, the queens stomp the runway in a fashion show, then perform a special version of RuPaul's song "Condragulations."

episodes.name: Phenomenon
episodes.overview: The previously chopped queens return to walk in a fashion runway show, then perform a choreographed number to RuPaul's song "Phenomenon," and comedian Nicole Byer guest judges.

episodes.name: RuPaulmark Channel
episodes.overview: After the queens come together for the first time, RuPaul hosts a holiday movie marathon featuring Hallmark Channel-inspired parodies.

episodes.name: The Bag Ball
episodes.overview: Tensions rise as queens put their design skills to the test in a pageant of bag-inspired couture, and showcase three bag-themed looks.

episodes.name: Disco-Mentary
episodes.overview: The queens funk it up in a disco-dancing documentary, complete with 70s fashions.

episodes.name: Bossy Rossy Ruboot
episodes.overview: The queens flex their improv skills in a reboot of the salacious talk show "Bossy Rossy," hosted by Ross Mathews; LGBT activist TS Madison guest judges.

episodes.name: Social Media: The Unverified Rusical
episodes.overview: It’s time for the Rusical! Queens must record lyrics and learn choreography as they perform in a tale on social media. Choreographer Jamal Sims guest judges; Anne Hathaway (The Devil Wears Prada) makes a virtual appearance in the workroom.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens impersonate celebrities in the legendary Snatch Game. LGBT activist TS Madison guest judges.

episodes.name: Freaky Friday Queens
episodes.overview: It’s Freaky Friday! The queens are challenged to make over each other into their own drag doppelgangers. Comedian and host Loni Love (Soul Plane) guest judges; psychic Char Margolis makes an appearance.

episodes.name: Pop! Goes the Queens
episodes.overview: The queens must create and brand their own versions of extravagant soft drinks. Current reigning America’s Next Drag Superstar Jaida Essence Hall makes a virtual appearance in the workroom.

episodes.name: Nice Queens Roast
episodes.overview: The queens take part in a comedy roast of former Drag Race "Miss Congeniality" winners - Heidi N Closet, Nina West and Valentina. Comedian and host Loni Love (Soul Plane) guest judges; Norvina (Instant Influencer) makes a guest appearance.

episodes.name: Henny, I Shrunk the Drag Queens!
episodes.overview: The queens flex their acting skills in a new sci-fi adventure, playing tiny shrunken drag queens. Cynthia Erivo (Genius: Aretha) guest judges; Scarlett Johansson (Black Widow) makes a virtual appearance in the workroom.

episodes.name: Gettin' Lucky
episodes.overview: The queens write and record lyrics as they perform to the world premiere of RuPaul's new song "Lucky". Choreographer Jamal Sims (Disney's Aladdin) makes a guest appearance.

episodes.name: Reunited
episodes.overview: The season 13 queens are back to dish on all the moments that made this season unforgettable. This gag-worthy reunion will feature up close and personal interviews, original music videos, and a special lip sync.

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: It's time to crown our winner, baby! The top 4 queens compete in a finale lip sync smackdown in the race to crown "America's Next Drag Superstar." The queens also pick a Miss Congeniality.

seasons.name: Season 14
seasons.overview: The fourteenth season of RuPaul's Drag Race premiered on January 7, 2022. The reality competition series, broadcast on VH1 in the United States, showcases 14 new queens competing for the title of "America's Next Drag Superstar".

episodes.name: Big Opening No. 1
episodes.overview: Lizzo guest judges part one of the Season 14 premiere, and a new set of queens stars in a dizzying photo shoot, performs in a talent show and walks the runway in Signature Showstopping Drag.

episodes.name: Big Opening No. 2
episodes.overview: The remaining queens of the brand new cast bring their gifts to a talent show; singer/songwriter Alicia Keys guest judges.

episodes.name: A Pair Of Balls
episodes.overview: The queens put their design skills to the test in a Double Ball challenge, stomping the runway in 42 fashion looks. Christine Chiu (Bling Empire) guest judges.

episodes.name: She's a Super Tease
episodes.overview: The queens star in self-produced Season 14 teaser trailers, Jennifer Lopez sends the girls a message before the Night of a Thousand JLos runway, and Loni Love sits in with the judges.

episodes.name: Save a Queen
episodes.overview: First-eliminated queens from past seasons return to star in parody PSA commercials, the category on the runway is Spring Has Sprung, and singer Ava Max sits in with the judges.

episodes.name: Glamazon Prime
episodes.overview: The queens repurpose unconventional materials from Glamazon Prime shipping boxes into high-fashion runway looks, and Taraji P. Henson sits in with the judges.

episodes.name: The Daytona Wind
episodes.overview: The queens star in the over-the-top soap opera "The Daytona Wind" and serve Chaps on the Runway, and Ts Madison sits in with the judges.

episodes.name: 60s Girl Groups
episodes.overview: The queens read each other for filth, write and perform 60s girl group-inspired songs and pour their hearts into their runway lewks, and comedian Alec Mapa sits in with the judges.

episodes.name: Menzeses
episodes.overview: The queens must lead Drag Con panel discussions about the multi-faceted world of menz: dating, fatherhood, and toxic masculinity; comedian Nicole Byer guest judges.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens impersonate celebrities in Snatch Game; Drag Race royalty Raven and actress Dove Cameron ("Descendants") play the game.

episodes.name: An Extra Special Episode
episodes.overview: RuPaul introduces a twist that leaves the dolls gagging.

episodes.name: Moulin Ru: The Rusical
episodes.overview: The queens go to Gay Paree, in the romantic musical, Moulin Ru; singer Andra Day ("The United States vs. Billie Holiday") guest judges; actor Leslie Jordan ("Will & Grace") guest stars.

episodes.name: The Ross Mathews Roast
episodes.overview: Anastasia Beverly Hills President Norvina stops by as the queens paint the faces of RuPaul and Dolly Parton on a mural, Ross Mathews gets roasted, and Dulcé Sloan sits in with the judges.

episodes.name: Catwalk
episodes.overview: For their final challenge, the Top Five queens design costumes, learn choreography and write song lyrics for their music video debuts in RuPaul's "Catwalk."

episodes.name: Reunited!
episodes.overview: One week away from the Grand Finale, the contestants return to discuss the season’s gaggiest moments.

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: The final 5 must face off in Showgirl Showdown for $150,000 and the title of America's Next Drag Superstar.

seasons.name: Season 15
seasons.overview: This season features the largest cast in the show's history, with sixteen queens competing and the largest cash prize, with the winner earning $200,000. It is also the first season to feature biological relatives, twins Sugar and Spice. Series judges Michelle Visage, Carson Kressley, and Ross Mathews returned, and Ts Madison, who had previously appeared as a recurring guest judge, joined the rotating judges panel.

episodes.name: One Night Only, Part 1
episodes.overview: She's back again; the unbearably long wait is over as RuPaul returns with a brand new field of gorgeous and talented sequin-sporting queens.

episodes.name: One Night Only, Part 2
episodes.overview: A new cast of queens, competing to be crowned America's Next Drag Superstar, must show off their performance skills in a talent show; singer Ariana Grande guest judges.

episodes.name: All Queens Go To Heaven
episodes.overview: In this heavenly acting challenge, the queens must create infomercials for a queer afterlife. Country singer Maren Morris and LGBT activist Ts Madison guest judge.

episodes.name: Supersized Snatch Game
episodes.overview: Ru serves up a double helping of the celebrity impersonation game show, with the queens playing in two rounds, with two different casts of characters. Amandla Stenberg (The Hate U Give) guest judges.

episodes.name: House Of Fashion
episodes.overview: The queens must turn home decor into haute couture; actress Janelle Monae guest judges.

episodes.name: Old Friends Gold
episodes.overview: The queens fast forward 50 years to perform in old lady girl groups, singing about life, love, and growing old with your besties. Actress/ comedian Megan Stalter (Hacks) guest judges.

episodes.name: The Daytona Wind 2
episodes.overview: The queens exchange flatulence for canned joy, as the melodramatic act challenge returns in surreal sitcom form; actor Harvey Guillén guest judges.

episodes.name: LipSync Lalaparuza Smackdown
episodes.overview: Strategy and alliances emerge as the queens face off in a series of lip syncs, all leading to a final sudden death elimination round.

episodes.name: The Crystal Ball: Episode 200
episodes.overview: Drag Race celebrates it’s milestone 200th episode. The queens design outfits feature the 15th year anniversary gift: crystals. Julia Garner (Inventing Anna; Ozark) guest judges.

episodes.name: 50/50's Most Gagworthy Stars
episodes.overview: The queens get up close and personal with celebrities for TV's sketchiest newsmagazine, 50/50; the runway, category is Night Of 1000 Beyoncés; special guests Charo, Frankie Grande and Love Connie.

episodes.name: Two Queens, One Joke
episodes.overview: The queens perform stand-up comedy in pairs, but an odd number of queens causes for some drama. Comedian Ali Wong (Ali Wong: Baby Cobra) guest judges.

episodes.name: Wigloose: The Rusical!
episodes.overview: This season’s Rusical is set in the small town of West Bumtuck, where drag has been outlawed. An underground alliance forms to try and defeat the bigots. Country music sensation Orville Peck guest judges.

episodes.name: Teacher Makeovers
episodes.overview: The queens give drag makeovers to hard-working teachers, from kindergarten to high school. Queer pop musician Hayley Kiyoko guest judges.

episodes.name: Blame It On The Edit
episodes.overview: The final queens collab with RuPaul on a remix of his song “Blame It On The Edit,” recording their own verses and creating a space-themed music video.

episodes.name: Reunited!
episodes.overview: One week away from the Grand Finale, the queens return to discuss the season's gaggiest moments.

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: RuPaul crowns America's Next Drag Superstar in an epic battle for the grand prize of $200,000.

seasons.name: Season 16
seasons.overview: The sixteenth season of Drag Race showcases fourteen drag queens competing for the title of America's Next Drag Superstar, a one-year supply of Anastasia Beverly Hills cosmetics, a crown and scepter from Fierce Drag Jewels and a cash prize of $200,000.

episodes.name: Rate-A-Queen
episodes.overview: Part 1 of the epic two part premiere. A new cast of queens, competing to be crowned America’s Next Drag Superstar, must show off their performance skills in a talent show. Oscar-winning actress Charlize Theron guest judges.

episodes.name: Queen Choice Awards
episodes.overview: Part 2 of the epic two part premiere. A new cast of queens, competing to be crowned America’s Next Drag Superstar, must show off their performance skills in a talent show. Superstar singer Becky G guest judges.

episodes.name: The Mother of All Balls
episodes.overview: The two groups of queens meet for the first time. Tensions rise as queens put their design skills to the test in a pageant of mother-inspired couture, and showcase three mom-themed looks. Iconic fashion designer Isaac Mizrahi guest judges.

episodes.name: RDR Live!
episodes.overview: Live from Tuckahoe, it’s RDR Live! The queens are challenged to serve up laughs in a hilarious send-up of the iconic sketch comedy show. Actress and three-time SNL host Sarah Michelle Gellar guest judges.

episodes.name: Girl Groups
episodes.overview: The queens are tasked with writing and performing their own verses, for RuPaul songs from his new album Black Butta. Swedish synth-pop duo Icona Pop guest judge.

episodes.name: Welcome to the DollHouse
episodes.overview: After a flamenco dance with Spanish sensation Charo, the queens must design their own dolls, based on their drag personas. Superstar stylist Law Roach guest judges.

episodes.name: The Sound of Rusic
episodes.overview: This season’s Rusical is set high in the Swish Alps, as a young queen called Mariah goes in search of a musical outlet for her inner freak. Legendary director Adam Shankman guest judges.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: After the iconic Reading challenge, the queens impersonate celebrities in the classic quick-fire comedy game show. All Stars winner Chad Michaels drops by the werkroom; actress Kyra Sedgwick guest judges.

episodes.name: See You Next Wednesday
episodes.overview: Morticia meets Mugler as the queens create a Neo-Goth look from scratch, using only black, white and gray fabric. Drop dead gorgeous model and actress Kaia Gerber guest judges.

episodes.name: Werq the World
episodes.overview: The queens let their voices be heard in an inspirational political anthem, and exercise their right to shake their groove thing. Choreographer Jamal Sims guest judges.

episodes.name: Corporate Queens
episodes.overview: The queens must devise and present comical Drag Awareness seminars in front of a live audience of corporate employees, and actor and comedian Joel Kim Booster guest judges.

episodes.name: Bathroom Hunties
episodes.overview: Nature calls as the queens star in the hot new design show "Bathroom Hunties," decorating and showcasing over-the-top powder rooms, and actress Mayan Lopez guest judges.

episodes.name: Drag Race Vegas Live! Makeovers
episodes.overview: Hunky male dancers from the RuPaul’s Drag Race LIVE! show in Las Vegas drop by the werkroom, to be made over into devastating drag queens. Country star Kelsea Ballerini guest judges.

episodes.name: Booked & Blessed
episodes.overview: The queens dig deep to write their memoirs, pose for a book cover photo shoot, and get grilled by podcaster Matt Rogers, and journalist and author Ronan Farrow guest judges.

episodes.name: LipSync Lalaparuza Smackdown Reunited
episodes.overview: All the eliminated queens return to battle it out in a LipSync Lalaparuza Smackdown, with nine lip syncs and a cash prize of $50,000 on the line.

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: The top queens face off in an epic evening of performances and lip syncs, as they compete for the title of America’s Next Drag Superstar and a grand prize of $200,000.

episodes.name: Squirrel Games
episodes.overview: Drag Race is back, doing what it does best: parodying the buzziest reality shows on TV. A new cast of queens must survive a deadly game of “Ru Light, Green Light,” before showing off their skills in a talent show. Superstar Katy Perry guest judges.

episodes.name: Drag Queens Got Talent - Part 2
episodes.overview: The second half of the new cast of 14 queens, competing to be crowned America's Next Drag Superstar, must show off their performance skills in a talent show; rapper and singer Doechii guest judges.

episodes.name: Monopulence!
episodes.overview: The queens take fashion inspiration from the board game Monopoly and must create from scratch an outfit that screams that they own everything; actress and comedian Sandra Bernhard becomes a guest judge.

episodes.name: Bitch, I'm A Drag Queen!
episodes.overview: The queens receive the task of singing songs based on memorable moments from "Drag Race" history; actress Julia Schlaepfer guest judges.

episodes.name: RDR Live!
episodes.overview: Live from Tuckahoe, it's RDR Live! The queens are challenged to serve up laughs in a hilarious send-up of the iconic sketch comedy show. Actor, writer and director Paul W. Downs (Hacks, Broad City) guest judges.

episodes.name: Let's Get Sea Sickening Ball
episodes.overview: Tensions rise as the queens put their design skills to the test in a pageant of ocean-inspired couture and showcase three fishy looks; actress and model Hunter Schafer and stylist Law Roach gue.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens impersonate celebrities in the classic quick-fire comedy game show. Global All Stars winner Alyssa Edwards drops by the werkroom; actress and comedian Quinta Brunson (Abbott Elementary) guest judges.

episodes.name: The Wicked Wiz of Oz: The Rusical!
episodes.overview: This season's Rusical is inspired by a mashup of "Wicked, The Wizard of Oz" and "The Wiz." Jamal Sims choreographs the queens; singer Adam Lambert guest judges.

episodes.name: Heavens To Betsey!
episodes.overview: After the iconic Reading challenge, the queens rock out with their frocks out, as they create a look worthy of a Betsey Johnson fashion collection. The fashion icon herself, Betsey Johnson, guest judges.

episodes.name: The Villains Roast
episodes.overview: The queens pay a comedy tribute to three of the shadiest queens in Drag Race herstory: Kandy Muse, Mistress Isabelle Brooks, and Plane Jane. Comedian Whitney Cummings guest judges.

episodes.name: Ross Mathews vs. The Ducks
episodes.overview: As a tribute to Truman Capote and his Swans, the queens must act up a storm in a high camp tale of betrayal. Cheyenne Jackson (American Horror Story) directs; singer Sam Smith guest judges.

episodes.name: Charisma, Uniqueness, Nerve & Talent Monologues
episodes.overview: The queens share hilarious and heartwarming true stories in a performance challenge with a twist: their partners must act out the stories through interpretive dance. Jerrod Carmichael (Jerrod Carmichael Reality Show) guest judges.

episodes.name: Drag Baby Mamas
episodes.overview: The queens make over some extra special drag newbies: their moms and dads. June Diane Raphael (Grace and Frankie) guest judges.

episodes.name: How's Your Headliner?
episodes.overview: The queens audition to star in RuPaul's Drag Race LIVE! at Flamingo Las Vegas. Tracee Ellis Ross (black-ish) guest judges.

episodes.name: Lip Sync Lalaparuza Smackdown
episodes.overview: All of the eliminated queens return to battle it out in a Lip Sync Lalaparuza Smackdown, with eight lip syncs, and a cash prize of $50,000 on the line.

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: The top queens face off in an epic evening of performances and lip syncs as they compete for a grand prize of $200,000. Superstar Liza Minnelli joins RuPaul on stage.

shows.name: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars
shows.overview: The most celebrated competitors from RuPaul's Drag Race vie for a second chance to enter Drag Race herstory. This drag queen showdown is filled with plenty of heated competition, lip-syncing for the legacy, and, of course, the All-Stars Snatch Game.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: They come armed with stilettos, feathers, and sequins, prepared for a battle where one false move-or eyelash-could spell doom. They are the best of the best, the top queens from Drag Race seasons 1-4, and they're ready to lip-synch for their lives to determine which of these all-stars will claim the ultimate title and be declared Queen amongst queens.

episodes.name: It Takes Two
episodes.overview: In the season premiere, the queens have to produce high fashion editorial photo spreads.

episodes.name: RuPaul's Gaff-In
episodes.overview: The Queens go full camp to prove that there's more to being a drag superstar than simply relying on that body.

episodes.name: Queens Behaving Badly
episodes.overview: The queens hit the streets of Hollywood to prank unsuspecting passers-by. RuPaul's extra special guest judges are funny lady Rachel Dratch and the world's first supermodel, Janice Dickinson.

episodes.name: All Star Girl Groups
episodes.overview: Legendary children Kady Z, Jillian Hervey and Kelly Osbourne join the queens to form All Star girl groups in a battle of the divas for the fiercest set.

episodes.name: Dynamic Drag Duos
episodes.overview: The final four assume super hero and super foe alter egos and go to epic heights to vanquish their nemesis.

episodes.name: The Grand Finale
episodes.overview: For the final challenge, RuPaul sends her All Stars on a junket that culminates with a stand-up routine at L.A.’s Comedy Store.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: A twist on the mega-hit RuPaul's Drag Race as queens from previous seasons are pitted against each other in a wig-to-wig drag battle royale.

episodes.name: All Star Talent Show Extravaganza
episodes.overview: Ten Queens return to compete for $100,000 and a place in the Drag Race Hall of Fame. The first test is to compete in a drag talent show. With guest judge Raven-Symoné.

episodes.name: All Stars Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens impersonate celebrities in a quick-witted TV game show and burn rubber in a latex runway. With guest judge Ross Mathews.

episodes.name: HERstory Of The World
episodes.overview: The queens are challenged to perform in a lip-syncing dance number inspired by the legendary historical women. Fashion designer Jeremy Scott guest judges.

episodes.name: Drag Movie Shequels
episodes.overview: The queens acting chops are tested in parody movie sequels of RuPaul's favorite movies. Pussycat Doll Nicole Scherzinger guest judges.

episodes.name: Revenge Of The Queens
episodes.overview: The queens must perform a live stand-up comedy act in front of an audience of judgmental drag queens. Ross Mathews returns to guest judge.

episodes.name: Drag Fish Tank
episodes.overview: The queens design and market drag-influenced products. Entrepreneur Marcus Lemonis (CNBC's The Profit) co-stars, and comedian Graham Norton guest judges.

episodes.name: Family That Drags Together
episodes.overview: The queens makeover family members; actress Aubrey Plaza judges

episodes.name: All Stars Supergroup
episodes.overview: The queens must write original rap lyrics and perform as a girl group; crowning a winner.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.overview: The All Star queens reunite to dish about the most shocking, glamorous and sickening moments of the season. Hosted by the Emmy Award winning RuPaul.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: All Stars compete for $100,000 and a chance to be inducted into RuPaul's Drag Race Hall of Fame.

episodes.name: All-Star Variety Show
episodes.overview: A mystery 10th queen joins the nine All Stars competing for $100,000 and a place in the Drag Race Hall of Fame. The first test is to compete in a drag variety show.

episodes.name: Divas Lip Sync Live
episodes.overview: The queens go full diva in a lip-syncing dance number inspired by the classic TV specials "VH1 Divas Live". With guest judge Vanessa Williams and choreographer Todrick Hall.

episodes.name: The B*tchelor
episodes.overview: The queens' improvisation skills are tested in an unscripted dating show. Constance Zimmer and Jeffrey Bowyer-Chapman guest judge.

episodes.name: All Stars Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens impersonate celebrities in a quick-witted TV game show. Fashion designer Marc Jacobs stops by the workroom, while Kristin Chenoweth and Nicole Byer (Girl Code) guest judge.

episodes.name: Pop Art Ball
episodes.overview: The queens design wearable soup cans inspired by Andy Warhol, and create Studio 54 disco looks. Tituss Burgess and Shay Mitchell guest judge.

episodes.name: Handmaids To Kitty Girls
episodes.overview: The eliminated queens return to the competition for revenge. But first the queens must audition for RuPaul's new girl group, the Kitty Girls. Spice Girl Emma Bunton ("Baby Spice") and Adam Lambert guest judge.

episodes.name: My Best Squirrelfriend's Dragsmaids Wedding Trip
episodes.overview: The queens’ acting chops are tested in a girl comedy blockbuster scene. Democratic Leader Nancy Pelosi stops by the workroom, while Chris Colfer and Garcelle Beauvais guest judge.

episodes.name: A Jury Of Their Queers
episodes.overview: The queens must write and perform a rap on RuPaul’s new hit single and conquer a one-take choreography performance. But before a winner can be crowned, RuPaul invites the eliminated queens to weigh in.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Unforgettable queens and Drag Race royalty take another shot at capturing the crown on RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars. The competitions will be as fierce as the runways, but only one queen can cement her legacy in The Drag Race Hall of Fame.

episodes.name: All Star Super Queen Variety Show
episodes.overview: The Queens' first challenge is a salute to LGBTQ troops in an All Star-Spangled Variety Show; extra special guest judge Jenifer Lewis joins.

episodes.name: Super Girl Groups, Henny
episodes.overview: RuPaul's Drag Race Season 3 contestant Stacy Layne Matthews returns for a musical collaboration with the queens of All Stars Season 4.

episodes.name: Snatch Game of Love
episodes.overview: The queens try out their best celebrity impressions for a romantic take on Snatch Game, and guest judges Gus Kenworthy and Keiynan Lonsdale weigh in on the competition.

episodes.name: Jersey Justice
episodes.overview: The All Stars get into character as litigants on an unscripted courtroom parody with New Jersey Justice Michelle Visage, and Zoe Kravitz and Erica Ash sit in as guest judges.

episodes.name: Roast In Peace
episodes.overview: The All Stars put their stand-up comedy chops to the test in a eulogy-style Roast of Lady Bunny, and Cecily Strong and Yvette Nicole Brown guest-judge the competition.

episodes.name: LaLaPaRuZa
episodes.overview: The All Stars are in for a surprise when they discover that the eliminated queens have returned for a lip sync smackdown and the opportunity to re-enter the competition.

episodes.name: Queens Of Clubs
episodes.overview: The All Stars design their own nightclubs (complete with entertainment and VIP experiences), and Rita Ora and New York City nightlife promoter Susanne Bartsch guest judge.

episodes.name: RuPaul's Best Judy's Race
episodes.overview: The All Stars give their best friends drag queen makeovers and perform a Judy Garland tribute, and Frances Bean Cobain and Ellen Pompeo sit in on the judges' panel.

episodes.name: Sex And The Kitty, Girl 3
episodes.overview: The All Stars put their acting skills to the test in a "Sex and the City"-inspired mockumentary, and Felicity Huffman and Jason Wu sit in on the judges' panel.

episodes.name: Super Queen Grand Finale
episodes.overview: In the final challenge of the season, the remaining girls write superhero-inspired lyrics and perform original choreography for RuPaul's "Super Queen".

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Drag Race royalty Alexis Mateo, Blair St. Clair, Derrick Barry, India Ferrah, Jujubee, Mariah Paris Balenciaga, Mayhem Miller, Miz Cracker, Ongina and Shea Coulee sashay back onto the runway for a chance at snatching the All Stars crown and nabbing a spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame.

episodes.name: All Star Variety Extravaganza
episodes.overview: The Season 5 All Stars make their werkroom entrances, extra special guest judge Ricky Martin gives a lesson in bilingual shade, and a new elimination twist is Ruvealed.

episodes.name: I’m In Love!
episodes.overview: The All Stars perform girl-group songs about their celebrity crushes and strut the runway in Love the Skin You're In lewks, and Tessa Thompson and Madison Beer guest judge.

episodes.name: Get A Room!
episodes.overview: The All Stars design their own boutique hotel suite experiences and show off three-in-one lewks on the runway, and Nicole Byer and Martyn Lawrence Bullard guest judge.

episodes.name: SheMZ
episodes.overview: The All Stars improv their way through celebrity scandals on a TMZ-inspired tabloid reality series and then walk the runway in camo couture, and Sarah Hyland guest judges.

episodes.name: Snatch Game of Love
episodes.overview: Guest judges Tommy Dorfman and Jeffrey Bowyer-Chapman join the All Stars for a dating-themed version of Snatch Game, and the category on the runway is Prom Queen Fantasy.

episodes.name: The Charles Family Backyard Ball
episodes.overview: For the barbecue-themed Charles Family Backyard Ball, the All Stars design runway lewks using materials that can be found in a yard, and Bebe Rexha guest judges.

episodes.name: Stand-Up Smackdown
episodes.overview: The All Stars perform stand-up sets for guest judges Sam Richardson and Jane Krakowski at RuPaul's Shady Shack, and the category on the runway is Freak Out.

episodes.name: Clap Back!
episodes.overview: Before the next All Star is inducted into the Drag Race Hall of Fame, the eliminated queens return, and the Top Three girls write and perform verses of RuPaul's "Clap Back!".

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Thirteen legendary queens return to RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars to claim a spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame! With more gag-worthy talents, jaw-dropping looks and epic performances, this is the biggest season of All Stars ever!

episodes.name: All Star Variety Extravaganza
episodes.overview: The Queens of All Stars 6 are back to compete for a spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame. To kick off the competition, the dolls showcase their best talents on the Main Stage. Plus, the iconic Miss Piggy pops by to prove that reading IS fundamental.

episodes.name: The Blue Ball
episodes.overview: The All Stars storm the runway in their bold and blue-tiful best - in the Blue Ball! Guest Judge Big Freedia helps decide whose design will earn a blue ribbon.

episodes.name: Side Hustles
episodes.overview: Even the best queen needs a side hustle, so the All Stars must create commercials to sell their services. Tia Mowry joins as guest judge.

episodes.name: Halftime Headliners
episodes.overview: Fireworks fly as the All Stars celebrate and impersonate their favorite divas in an epic halftime show. Jamal Sims whips the dolls into shape as guest choreographer and judge.

episodes.name: Pink Table Talk
episodes.overview: The All Stars serve up piping hot tea as hosts of an up close and personal talk show, Pink Table Talk. Guest Judge Aisha Tyler stops by to join the kiki.

episodes.name: Ru-Merican Horror Story: Coven Girl
episodes.overview: Who is the baddest witch of all? Find out as the All Stars showcase their acting chops in this spooky spoof. Superstar Angela Bassett offers bewitching advice, and Guest Judge Emma Roberts stops by to cast a spell of her own.

episodes.name: Show Up Queen
episodes.overview: Drag and activism come together as the All Stars record and perform an inspiring anthem: "Show Up Queen!" Designer extraordinaire Zaldy brings his eye for fashion to the judging panel.

episodes.name: Snatch Game of Love
episodes.overview: The All Stars serve up their best celebrity impressions in a dating show version of the Snatch Game. Who's getting lucky? Guest judges Fortune Feimster and Cheyenne Jackson search for their perfect snatch match; superstar designer Ms. Tina Knowles- Lawson joins on the mainstage.

episodes.name: Drag Tots
episodes.overview: The All Stars turn themselves into magical characters fit for the hit animated series, Drag Tots. Guest Judge Charli XCX stops by for this fierce foray into fantasy and fun.

episodes.name: Rudemption Lip-Sync Smackdown
episodes.overview: The eliminated queens are back to compete in an epic Lip Sync Smackdown and a chance to return to the competition.

episodes.name: The Charisma, Uniqueness, Nerve and Talent Monologues
episodes.overview: The All Stars take the stage to share hilarious and heartwarming true stories in a performance challenge that decides who makes it to the Grand Finale! Actors Jermaine Fowler and Alec Mapa coach the queens; writer/director Justin Simien joins the judges’ panel.

episodes.name: This Is Our Country
episodes.overview: Who will take home the crown? A spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame is at stake as the finalists write, record, and perform verses to RuPaul's new song This is Our Country, featuring country music legend Tanya Tucker.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: For the first time ever in the herstory of RuPaul's Drag Race, the series will feature a cast of all former winners returning to compete for the title "Queen of All Queens" and a cash prize of $200,000.

episodes.name: Legends
episodes.overview: Eight legendary RuPaul's Drag Race winners have returned to battle for the title of "Queen of All Queens." After a raucous reading challenge and an epic runway session with supermodel Naomi Campbell, our queens must put together a show-stopping performance of RuPaul's song "Legends." Special Guest Judge Cameron Diaz brings her star power to the Drag Race panel.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: For the first time in Drag Race herstory, the crowned queens must perform two iconic celebrity impersonations in a Snatch Game Double-Header! International style icon Daphne Guiness joins the judges' panel.

episodes.name: The Realness of Fortune Ball
episodes.overview: The legendary queens put their spin on the classic Drag Race ball challenge, serving 3 looks each in the "Realness of Fortune" Ball. Vanna White is in the house to make sure things are letter-perfect, and actress Kirby Howell-Baptiste graces the judges' panel.

episodes.name: Fairytale Justice
episodes.overview: All rise! The legends are telling tall tales in court as they bring their best storybook characters to the witness stand in this twisted improv challenge. Drag Race veteran Jeffrey Bowyer-Chapman is back to testify on the judges' panel.

episodes.name: Draguation Speeches
episodes.overview: The queens deliver inspiring and irreverent commencement speeches for draguates around the world. Nikki Glaser shares her comedic expertise and helps Mama Ru pick this week's Valedictorian.

episodes.name: Total Ru-quest Live
episodes.overview: The queens live out their Y2K girl group fantasies on a dragtastic tribute to TRL! And on the runway, category is: Night of 1,000 Dolly Partons. Pop star Tove Lo joins the judges' panel.

episodes.name: Legendary Legend Looks
episodes.overview: Fashion Icon and Supermodel of the World, Rupaul, challenges the crowned queens to use their divine design skills to transform eight of her legendary looks. Iconic and effervescent designer Betsey Johnson spices up the judges' panel.

episodes.name: Santa's School for Girls
episodes.overview: Ho ho ho! The queens make the yuletide gayer as they star in the twisted new holiday cult classic, "Santa's School for Girls." Acclaimed film director Janicza Bravo brings her expertise to set, and reviews the queens' performances on the judges panel.

episodes.name: Dance Like a Drag Queen
episodes.overview: The queens try to break the internet by creating an original dance video challenge. On the runway, category is: What Lies Beneath. Ben Platt lends his voice to the judges' panel.

episodes.name: The Kennedy Davenport Center Honors Hall of Shade
episodes.overview: The queens take the stage to roast each other at the first-ever Kennedy Davenport Center "Hall of Shade" Honors. Pulitzer prize-winning journalist, Ronan Farrow, joins the esteemed judges' panel.

episodes.name: Drag Race Gives Back Variety Extravaganza
episodes.overview: The crowned queens give 'til it hurts, as they star in a charity talent show extravaganza! But first, they each join RuPaul and Michelle Visage for an intimate tic-tac chit-chat! Super-hot actress and comedian Hannah Einbinder joins the judges' panel.

episodes.name: Lip Sync LaLaPaRuza
episodes.overview: It's a lip sync battle royale, as the crowned queens take the stage for the most epic Lip Sync LalaPaRuza in Drag Race herstory. And in the end, one legend will be crowned Queen of All Queens.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars brings back 12 of your favorite queens from across the Ru-niverse to compete for a coveted spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame! Plus, a new "Fame Games" twist means there's more than one way to win!

episodes.name: The Fame Games
episodes.overview: Twelve Drag Race All Stars return for a second chance at the crown and a cash prize of $200,000. And this season, there are two ways to win! After a sickening fashion show mini-challenge, the queens thrill iconic guest judge Idina Menzel.

episodes.name: It's RDR Live!
episodes.overview: “Live from Tuckahoe... it’s RDR Live!” The All Stars are challenged to serve up laughs in a hilarious Drag Race send-up of the iconic sketch comedy show. SNL alum Bobby Moynihan and special guest judge Robin Thede lend their comedic expertise.

episodes.name: The Supermarket Ball
episodes.overview: The All Stars storm the runway – and the grocery aisle – transforming everyday supermarket items into supermodel-worthy fashions! Guest judge Jojo Siwa is having a ball as she checks out the parade of 30 gagworthy garments.

episodes.name: Screen Queens
episodes.overview: The Golden Age of Television gets even sparklier, as the All Stars create and star in their own sickening scripted TV series trailers, directed by Emmy® Award winner Michelle Visage. Euphoria actress Maude Apatow helps decide which trailer is “must-she TV.”

episodes.name: Snatch Game of Love
episodes.overview: Love is in the air as the queens serve up their flirtiest celebrity impersonations for guest judges Bowen Yang and Matt Rogers in the romantic and raucous “Snatch Game of Love.” But, before the queens hit the runway, the Werkroom is rocked by a game-changing shocker.

episodes.name: JOAN: The Unauthorized Rusical
episodes.overview: The All Stars channel Hollywood royalty, singing and dancing in “JOAN: The Unauthorized Rusical,” celebrating “Mommie Dearest” herself, Joan Crawford! Then, from one legend to another... On the Runway, category is “Night of 1,000 Grace Joneses.” Choreographer and director Adam Shankman coaches the queens and joins the judges’ panel.

episodes.name: Forensic Queens
episodes.overview: The Queens’ improv talents are on full display, as they star in a twisted true-crime show, examining the mystery, “Wha-Ha-Happened to Lil’ Poundcake.”

episodes.name: You're a Winner Baby!
episodes.overview: RuPaul challenges the queens to create looks worthy of the Drag Race Hall of Fame, inspired by past All Stars champions. Drag Race legends Raven and Shannel bring some style guidance to the workroom.

episodes.name: Carson Kressley, This is Your Gay Life
episodes.overview: The All Stars heat things up to roast beloved judge Carson Kressley in front of a live audience, including a very extra-special surprise guest queen & judge! Michelle Visage and comedian Alec Mapa coach the queens.

episodes.name: The Letter "L"
episodes.overview: Celebrating the L in LGBTQIA+ , the queens share the miracle of drag with new lesbian sisters, transforming the fabulous queer women into fabulous drag queens.

episodes.name: The Fame Games Variety Extravaganza
episodes.overview: They’re back! The eliminated queens return to the workroom and read each other to filth before showing off their charisma, uniqueness, nerve and talent one last time in the Fame Games Variety Extravaganza. Comedian Ego Nwodim joins the judges’ panel.

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: The time has come… to crown two queens! First, Ru will announce who fans voted “Queen of the Fame Games!” Then, our finalists will battle for a spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame!

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: Who will save the world? Drag Queens! RuPaul brings together eight of her most powerful All Stars to slay it forward in the name of charity. All season long, the queens will battle as they raise thousands of dollars for their favorite causes. But in the end, only one will win a coveted spot in the prestigious Drag Race Hall of Fame.

episodes.name: Drag Queens Save The World
episodes.overview: Eight All Stars return to compete to win $200,000 for their favorite charity, and a spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame. They serve up an epic performance of the anthem "Drag Queens Save the World," and Keke Palmer joins for this gagworthy premiere.

episodes.name: The Paint Ball
episodes.overview: The Queens present a total of 24 iconic looks on the runway - including hand-painted masterpieces created in the Werk Room - in the art-inspired Paint Ball. Oscar-nominated actor Stephanie Hsu joins the judges' panel to appraise the Queens' work.

episodes.name: Snatch Game of Love
episodes.overview: Romance is in the air as the Queens impersonate celebrities in the Snatch Game of Love. But when two All Stars want to play the same celeb, things get spicy! Meanwhile, a twist means that more badges are up for grabs! Pop superstar Anitta stops by.

episodes.name: Smokin' Hot Firefighter Makeover
episodes.overview: This week begins with fiery accusations, and when the Queens are tasked with transforming four sexy firefighters into hot pop stars, things really start to sizzle! Country music duo the Brothers Osborne join the judges panel and feel the heat.

episodes.name: Property Queens
episodes.overview: This week our All Stars' put their sales skills to the test, as they create raucous real estate commercials for some preposterous properties. Superstar Realtor Tracy Tutor and Comedian Alec Mapa stop by to assess what's on the market.

episodes.name: The National Drag Convention Roast
episodes.overview: While the ruby snippers cause icy vibes in the workroom, it’s hotter than an oven on the main stage, as the queens roast each other to a crisp. Television icon Ruta Lee joins the panel to witness the hilarious jabs.

episodes.name: Meeting In The Ladies Room
episodes.overview: This week, the All-Stars get slap happy as they costar with RuPaul in an acting challenge inspired by some of cinema’s most classic catfights. Foxy actor Colton Haynes joins the judging panel to take in all the drama!

episodes.name: Make Your Own Kind Of Rusic
episodes.overview: After hard feelings rock the workroom, Mama Ru challenges the dolls to create chart-topping looks inspired by her hit songs. Fashion icon Jeremy Scott joins the judge panel to decide which looks are bops and which are flops!

episodes.name: Rosemarie's Baby Shower: The Rusical
episodes.overview: This week, the All Stars dance with the devil in a spooky-ooky Rusical that leaves the judges shook! Dance music legend Kristine W joins the panel for a twisted good time.

episodes.name: Lip Sync LaLaPaRuza Smackdown
episodes.overview: The competition is closer than ever, so when Ru announces that the Queens must Lip Sync for their badges this week, the All Stars go into Assassin mode to slay the stage! Who will be the last Queen standing?

episodes.name: Grand Finale Variety Extravaganza: Part 1
episodes.overview: This week, Mama Ru drops a gag-worthy twist on the All-Stars... Before their final challenge of the season, the queens must cast a game-changing vote - and it's anybody’s crown to win!

episodes.name: Grand Finale Variety Extravaganza: Part 2
episodes.overview: It's the crowning moment of the two-part Grand Finale, and all the Queens hit the stage for an unforgettable Variety Extravaganza! Three badges are up for grabs, and a new voting twist could change everything! In the end, only one queen can win.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: Let the games begin! 18 returning queens compete in the first-ever Tournament of All Stars, battling through brackets to test their charisma, uniqueness, nerve & talent! But only one queen will claim $200,000 and a spot in the Drag Race Hall of Fame.

episodes.name: Winner Winner, Chicken Dinner
episodes.overview: The Tournament of All Stars kicks off with the first of three brackets! For this premiere challenge, the 6 Queens of Bracket 1 deliver head-banging heavy metal realness in an 80s-inspired music video.

episodes.name: Murder On The Dance Floor
episodes.overview: It's Week 2 of the first bracket, and the queens must make the judges drop dead with their improv performances in the whodunit, "Murder on the Dance Floor." Emmy award winning actor and red carpet darling, Colman Domingo, guest judges.

episodes.name: Hoop Queens Makeover
episodes.overview: It's a buzzer beater to the Semi Finals for this first bracket of queens as they scramble to makeover collegiate basketball players. Meanwhile, the MVQ point system has the dolls calling, "foul," on their sisters. Kate Beckinsale joins the judges panel.

episodes.name: Eight Ball
episodes.overview: A new bracket of queens arrive in the werkroom where lines are drawn in the sand between competitors. A special delivery from Ru has queens creating dope looks from items found in giant 8-balls. Nightlife icon, Susanne Bartsch, returns to turn the party.

episodes.name: Rappin' Roast
episodes.overview: After a gaggy MVQ Points Ceremony, the queens are ready to create the ultimate diss track and battle each other in a Rappin' Roast. Supernova superstar Chappell Roan stops by to get a taste of the hot and spicy bars.

episodes.name: Starrbooty: The Rebooty
episodes.overview: With the semi-finals at stake, it's heroes versus villains, as the queens funk it up for a dyn-o-mite performance of the movie rusical, "Starrbooty: The Rebooty." Legendary producer and director, Adam Shankman, choreographs and guest judges.

episodes.name: Wicked Good
episodes.overview: The final bracket of 6 queens descend onto the Main Stage to stake their claim for the Drag Race Hall of Fame. Working in teams the queens must create good and wicked witch looks for the runway. Ariana Grande and Cynthia Erivo enchant on the judges panel.

episodes.name: Stagecooch
episodes.overview: Coached by country superstar, Orville Peck, the queens divide into dueling country trios to perform honky tonk anthems at the first annual Stagecooch Festival. Drag Race choreographer extraordinaire Jamal Sims returns to the judges panel.

episodes.name: The Golden Bitchelor
episodes.overview: Things get real after a tense MVQ Points Ceremony. With 3 semi-final spots up for grabs, the queens vie for love and laughs in "The Golden Bitchelor" with "Fire Island" star Zane Phillips. Sitcom pro Mayan Lopez returns to help decide who will move on.

episodes.name: Tournament of All Stars Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The divine 9 Semi-Finalists return, and Mama Ru cranks up the heat by challenging them to serve their best celeb impersonations in the Snatch Game! Sarah Michelle Gellar slays the judges panel - and one All Star is sent home.

episodes.name: Tournament of All Stars Talent Invitational
episodes.overview: The 8 Semi-Finalists showcase their most gag-worthy talents in hopes of earning a spot in the finale. Superstar actress Devery Jacobs joins the judges- and one All Star is sent packing.

episodes.name: Tournament of All Stars Smackdown for the Crown
episodes.overview: One All Star returns to the competition, and everything is on the line as the final 8 Queens lip sync for the crown! Which Queen will snatch victory and be the newest face in the Drag Race Hall of Fame?

shows.ref_name: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars: UNTUCKED
shows.name: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars: UNTUCKED
shows.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway. See what happens behind the scenes when the queens let their tucks breathe... and let their emotions flow.

episodes.name: It Takes Two
episodes.overview: The queens get riled up when one queen storms off after harsh critiques from her peers.

episodes.name: RuPaul's Gaff-In
episodes.overview: The queens are surprised by a video message that leave many of the queens emotional.

episodes.name: Queens Behaving Badly
episodes.overview: The remaining All Stars bicker back stage about comments that were made on the runway.

episodes.name: All Star Girl Groups
episodes.overview: The remaining All Stars are greeted by their fellow band mates in the Untucked lounge.

episodes.name: Dynamic Drag Duos
episodes.overview: The remaining two teams get an earful from one queen until they get surprise questions from fans.

episodes.name: The Grand Finale
episodes.overview: For the first time ever, RuPaul surprises the queens in the lounge and has a final heart to heart with them before deciding the winner of All Stars.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: This season of Untucked featured the queens' backstage deliberation, a segment with the Lip Sync Assassin, their votes for the next eliminated queen, and a little interview of Michelle Visage and the eliminated queen.

episodes.name: All Star Variety Extravaganza
episodes.overview: After the All Stars perform in a variety show, Jujubee spills on the hostilities between Derrick Barry and India Ferrah, and the queens deliberate about the bottom two.

episodes.name: I'm In Love!
episodes.overview: After the All Stars' girl-group performances, the judges reveal their celebrity crushes, Miz Cracker grapples with her reputation, and Alexis Mateo gets emotional over voting.

episodes.name: Get A Room!
episodes.overview: After the All Stars design hotel suites, Mayhem Miller opens up about her personal struggles, Nicole Byer acts out dirty charades, and a lip sync assassin prepares for battle.

episodes.name: SheMZ
episodes.overview: After the All Stars improv on a TMZ-style show, Blair St. Clair reflects on being typecast, a lip sync assassin returns, and the eliminated queen opens up to Michelle Visage.

episodes.name: Snatch Game of Love
episodes.overview: After the Snatch Game of Love, Miz Cracker investigates potential backstabbing, an assassin makes her entrance, and Michelle Visage gets the tea on the messiness backstage.

episodes.name: The Charles Family Backyard Ball
episodes.overview: After a family barbecue-themed ball, RuPaul and her sisters kiki, questions linger about whether Alexis Mateo campaigned against Shea Coulee, and a lip sync assassin returns.

episodes.name: Stand-Up Smackdown
episodes.overview: After the All Stars perform stand-up, Blair St. Clair defends her set, Jujubee gets emotional over voting, and Michelle Visage has a one-on-one with the eliminated queen.

episodes.name: Clap Back!
episodes.overview: After the All Stars perform a finale number and reconvene with the eliminated queens, India Ferrah and Alexis Mateo make peace, and the Top Three queens prepare for their final lip sync.

episodes.name: All Star Variety Extravaganza
episodes.overview: Back in the Werkroom, after a glittering All Stars Variety Show, the queens reunite for the first time to untuck and spill the T. They anticipate the upcoming season which promises to be legendary, right out of the gate!

episodes.name: The Blue Ball
episodes.overview: After the first elimination the pressure is already on, the queens untuck and kiki about which All Star was the belle of the Ball and who dropped the ball altogether. They discuss voting strategies, and a friendship is put to the ultimate test!

episodes.name: Side Hustles
episodes.overview: The All Stars untuck and open up about the toughest elimination yet. Two past season sisters confront an old grudge, can they reinvest in a future of renewed drag sisterhood?

episodes.name: Halftime Headliners
episodes.overview: After an All Star studded stadium halftime show, the queens untuck and dish on their experiences from celebrities to go-go boys. Everyone slayed in the spotlight, but despite the lovefest, one queen must still sashay away.

episodes.name: Pink Table Talk
episodes.overview: The All Stars can make opposing patterns mesh, but it doesn’t mean their personalities will mesh too. The voting process has tensions flaring and certain queens struggle to cool down and get out of their heads, but the Tea just keeps flowing.

episodes.name: Ru-Merican Horror Story: Coven Girl
episodes.overview: RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars: Untucked! is the access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn’t see on the runway. See what happens behind the scenes when the queens let their tucks breathe… and let their emotions flow.

episodes.name: Show Up Queen
episodes.overview: Our All Stars untuck to spill the Tea, honey, about their personal connection to the legendary RuPaul herself. They gag over how Ru has affected their lives in and out of the werkroom. The Tea is spilled and the shenanigans are brought.

episodes.name: Snatch Game of Love
episodes.overview: The All Stars untuck, kiki and sip some well-deserved bubbly to celebrate the Pop Art of it all. As the competition narrows, jaws are dropped and dream bubbles get popped.

episodes.name: Drag Tots
episodes.overview: After tooning out in the Drag Tots challenge, the final 5 queens are spilling all the hot Tea. When Ru makes the rules you never know what you're gonna get except for twisted. So don't get caught without your wig on!

episodes.name: Rudemption Lip-Sync Smackdown
episodes.overview: The Big Ruveal has the All Stars Queens gagging on a twist none of them saw coming, but there's still time for final tête-à-têtes in the spirit of All Stars Drag sisterhood.

episodes.name: The Charisma, Uniqueness, Nerve and Talent Monologues
episodes.overview: One All Star proved herself by fighting her way back into the competition, but can she Shantay and stay? Heading into the battle of a Fierce Final Four means it's time to untuck and leave it all on the runway.

episodes.name: This is Our Country
episodes.overview: The Final Four All Stars reflect upon their growth. It's time for all but one legendary All Star to untuck and pack it all up in this Untucked finale.

episodes.name: Legends
episodes.overview: Backstage after their first performance and runway, 8 competing champions speculate about how new rules and potential alliances may may affect the season ahead. Guest Judge and Superfan Cameron Diaz visits the werkroom to kiki with the queens.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: After an epic Snatch Game, the queens are wondering who's on top, and who's getting blocked? Plus, a rousing game of "Kiki, Kai Kai, Marry" reveals some surprises about how the Queens really feel about each other. Guest Judge and fashion icon Daphne Guiness pops by to share some of her own style secrets.

episodes.name: The Realness of Fortune Ball
episodes.overview: As the Queens gush about each others' gorgeous ball looks and kiki about whose drag they would mop, the conversation takes an emotional turn. Guest Judge Kirby Baptiste-Howell talks fashion and gardening during her visit to the werkroom and scores herself an invite to the Drag Queen BBQ.

episodes.name: Fairytale Justice
episodes.overview: One queen is riding high after this week's challenge, but another gets salty when the group agrees that she'll be the next to get blocked; guest Judge Jeffrey Bowyer-Chapman visits and shares how Drag Race has affected the entire world.

episodes.name: Dragulation Speeches
episodes.overview: After their Draguation Speeches, the Queens share how their high school experiences shaped who they are today; a twist in the rules has everyone speculating how things will play out; Guest Judge Nikki Glaser joins the queens for a chat about passion.

episodes.name: Total Ru-quest Live
episodes.overview: The Queens reflect on their runway and share how Dolly Parton has inspired them. One queen's frustrations lead to an very stress relief moment for all the girls. And, just before the lip sync, two queens share a heartfelt moment, while another has an epiphany. Plus, Guest Judge Tove Lo talks to the queens about songwriting and style.

episodes.name: Legendary Legend Looks
episodes.overview: The competition heats up as the Queens realize that everyone is a threat, and this is still anyone's game. Legendary Guest Judge Betsey Johnson brings her quirky energy to the werkroom, shares stories of her epic life and offers insight about how to make it as an artist.

episodes.name: Santa's School for Girls
episodes.overview: The Queens cool off after the hottest runway yet. Following the acting challenge, the performances continue in the werkroom with the Queens serving up spot-on impressions of Queens from past seasons - and each other!

episodes.name: Dance Like Drag Queen
episodes.overview: As the end of the competition draws near, the Queens reminisce about the Queens they have blocked. Guest Judge Ben Platt stops by, the queens grill him about his nail polish, his boyfriend and his own possible drag future.

episodes.name: The Kennedy Davenport Center Honors Hall of Shade
episodes.overview: After an illuminating runway, a surprise guest awaits the Queens in the werkroom. Then, Guest Judge Ronan Farrow visits to ask some probing questions, and then the queens ask a few of their own. And finally, a game of "Two Truths and a Lie" uncovers a juicy secret that has everyone gooped!

episodes.name: Drag Race Gives Back Variety Extravaganza
episodes.overview: The penultimate episode has the Queens gagging over their variety show performances. Guest Judge Hannah Einbinder fangirls over the ladies - and the feeling is mutual. And, things get turnt when the girls play "Tower of Truth" and some piping hot tea is spilled!

episodes.name: Lip Sync LaLaPaRuza
episodes.overview: After an emotional moment with Ru on the main stage, the Queens head to the werkroom to get ready for the LaLaparuza Lip-Sync Smackdown for the Crown; the stakes couldn't be higher, as the Queens watch each other battle for big money.

episodes.name: The Fame Games
episodes.overview: After an emotional deliberation and a visit from guest judge Indina Menzel, the Queens realize that sending their competitors home is harder than expected.

episodes.name: It's RDR Live!
episodes.overview: In their second deliberation of the season, the All Stars discuss whether personal relationships or track record matter most when determining who goes home. And, the Fame Games kick off, featuring the runway looks of eliminated queens.

episodes.name: The Supermarket Ball
episodes.overview: After the Supermarket Ball, the Queens are in their feelings, and one contemplates a drastic decision. Guest judge and pop star Jojo Siwa kikis with the Queens about the importance of being yourself.

episodes.name: Screen Queens
episodes.overview: This week, the Queens are judged as a group, which has Queens pointing fingers and scrambling to save themselves. Guest judge Maude Apatow visits the Werk Room to fangirl over the All Stars.

episodes.name: Snatch Game of Love
episodes.overview: After a shocking turn of events, the Queens are left wondering how it will affect the game. Guest Judges Bowen Yang and Matt Rogers visit the Werk Room and share what Drag Race means to them.

episodes.name: JOAN: The Unauthorized Rusical!
episodes.overview: Deliberations continue to get more difficult as the Queens struggle to decide who should get the chop. Guest Judge Adam Shankman visits the Queens to celebrate the success of the Rusical challenge.

episodes.name: Forensic Queens
episodes.overview: After an emotional week, one of the Queens finds herself in the bottom again, while another tries to win favor with her fellow All Stars. Guest Judge and actress Javicia Leslie visits the Werk Room.

episodes.name: You’re a Winner Baby!
episodes.overview: As one All Star reconsiders a promise she made, the remaining contestants fight to keep their spot in the competition. Guest judge and Incubus frontman Brandon Boyd pops into the Werk Room.

episodes.name: Carson Kressley, This is Your Gay Life
episodes.overview: The All Stars are excited to receive words of encouragement from loved ones back home, but with so few queens left, figuring out who to eliminate is intense. Will one queen’s strategy to stay in the game pay off?

episodes.name: The Letter “L”
episodes.overview: After the makeover challenge, the Queens reflect on their amazing experiences with their new lesbian sisters. And Guest Judge Zooey Deschanel visits to talk nerves with the All Stars.

episodes.name: The Fame Games Variety Extravaganza
episodes.overview: While the finalists jockey for the crown, the competition revs up for the returning queens vying for the title, “Queen of the Fame Games!” Plus, Guest Judge Ego Nwodim visits with the Queens.

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: The Queens of All Stars 8 celebrate a gagworthy season. The Top Queens prepare for one ,final performance, and everyone wonders who will be the next Queen to be inducted into the Drag Race Hall of Fame!

episodes.name: Drag Queens Save The World
episodes.overview: The Queens are excited to raise money for their charities and showcase their talents on the mainstage! They speculate about who'll win the first Benefactress Badges of the season, and who'll get cut off. Guest Judge Keke Palmer pops in for a kiki!

episodes.name: The Paint Ball
episodes.overview: As the All Stars gag over each other's Paint Ball looks, they reflect on their walk-throughs with RuPaul. The Queens keep the arty party going with a raucous game of "Win, Lose or Bra." Guest Judge Stephanie Hsu visits.

episodes.name: Snatch Game of Love
episodes.overview: After The Snatch Game of Love, the Queens are gooped thinking about how this week's twist could impact the game - and their sisterhood. Guest Judge Anitta shows up to turn the party.

episodes.name: Smokin' Hot Firefighter Makeover
episodes.overview: After the makeovers, the Queens kiki with their hunky firemen. Guest Judges John & T.J. Osborne visit, and T.J. discuss the struggle of being gay in country music. And as a bonus, Firefighter Bradley shares his own extra-special party skills.

episodes.name: Property Queens
episodes.overview: As the All Stars struggle with the stress of the competition, Guest Judge Alec Mapa drops by to boost their spirits. Later, the Queens kiki and serve up impressions of past Ru girls and each other - until one cuts too close to home.

episodes.name: The National Drag Convention Roast
episodes.overview: After a surprise visit with Bob the Drag Queen, the All Stars get serious and discuss how they plan to use their platforms politically. Then, when Guest Judge Ruta Lee joins the queens, things get genuinely emotional and heartfelt.

episodes.name: Meeting In The Ladies Room
episodes.overview: After the Queens rave about acting opposite Mama Ru, one All Star uses her math skills to avoid getting snipped! Guest Judge Colton Haynes visits the Untucked Lounge, and a message from Drag Race Royalty brings one Queen to tears.

episodes.name: Make Your Own Kind Of Rusic
episodes.overview: After weeks of feeling out of sorts, one Queen opens up to her sisters. An emotional message from home gets the All Stars talking about their love lives. And guest judge Jeremy Scott dazzles in the Untucked Lounge.

episodes.name: Rosemarie's Baby Shower: The Rusical
episodes.overview: The All Stars praise each other for their sickening Rusical performances. Messages from home lead one Queen to discuss her journey of family acceptance. Guest Judge Kristine W, stops by and serenades the All Stars.

episodes.name: Lip Sync LaLaPaRuza Smackdown
episodes.overview: Two Queens prepare for their final battle in the Lip Sync Lalaparuza Smackdown. After they leave it all on the stage, the All Stars celebrate the winner and anticipate the final push towards the finale.

episodes.name: Grand Finale Variety Extravaganza: Part 1
episodes.overview: On an extra-special episode, crew members-turned-queens kiki in the Untucked Lounge. They dish about working on the show, and share what they really think of the queens! Ts Madison pops by to find out more.

episodes.name: Grand Finale Variety Extravaganza: Part 2
episodes.overview: After their final Runway, Guest Judge Connie Britton visits the Untucked Lounge. But as the Queens prepare to meet their fates on the main stage, uncertainty looms. Tonight, any of these Queens could make the Top Three and take home the Crown!

episodes.name: Winner Winner, Chicken Dinner
episodes.overview: The Bracket 1 Queens storm the Untucked Lounge for the first time in the Tournament of All Stars to dissect the points twist, which seriously affects how they play the game. Guest judge Ice Spice gags for the Queens’ looks.

episodes.name: Murder on the Dance Floor
episodes.overview: This week, the All Stars need more than a crystal ball to predict how many points they’ll have at the end of the night. Alliances crumble as the Queens wonder how they will make it to the semi-finals. Guest judge Colman Domingo helps the Queens loosen up.

episodes.name: Hoop Queens Makeovers
episodes.overview: Tensions peak as the Bracket 1 Queens face their final judgment before the semi-finals! The Lady Ballers join for a kiki and guest judge Kate Beckinsale brings Hollywood glamour to the Untucked lounge.

episodes.name: Eight Ball
episodes.overview: The Bracket 2 Queens stir the pot in the Untucked Lounge. As playful tension starts to brew, it's clear these girls aren't here for kumbaya... And one Queen's bottom placement pushes her to start playing strategically.

episodes.name: Rappin' Roast
episodes.overview: An emotional reveal on the main stage strikes a chord between two Queens. But as sisterhood blooms, another Queen presents a controversial proposal that could tear it apart. Guest judge Chappell Roan cements her icon status with the girls.

episodes.name: Starrbooty: The Rebooty
episodes.overview: The Bracket 2 Queens strategize right up until the final moments on the main stage. Despite some rocky moments, they agree that returning to All Stars was truly special. After a shocking twist, the semi-finalists celebrate.

episodes.name: Wicked Good
episodes.overview: The Bracket 3 Queens are feeling confident in the aftermath of the design challenge, while new friendships are forming in the Untucked Lounge. The wicked-fabulous Guest Judges Ariana Grande and Cynthia Erivo surprise the Queens with a sweet treat!

episodes.name: Stagecooch
episodes.overview: The Queens are feeling their Miley Cyrus looks. After a day of discussing points, gameplay is on everyone's minds - and one Queen worries that her sisters are not behind her. Another Queen's bold proclamation may have backed her into a corner.

episodes.name: The Golden Bitchelor
episodes.overview: The All Stars of Bracket 3 untuck one last time. Emotions run high as they wonder who will win this week's Maxi Challenge, how queens will award their final MVQ Points, and who will move on to the Semi-Finals.

episodes.name: Tournament of All Stars Snatch Game
episodes.overview: Before the first elimination, the Semi-Finalists face the heat in the Untucked Lounge. One Queen's gameplaying backfires, while guest judge Sarah Michelle Gellar's visit leaves everyone gagged.

episodes.name: Tournament of All Stars Talent Invitational
episodes.overview: With the Talent Show behind them, the Queens argue over who is in danger this week - and one Queen reflects on her emotional journey, as the final elimination looms.

episodes.name: Tournament of All Stars Smackdown for the Crown
episodes.overview: Excitement and nerves fill the werkroom as the Queens prep for the Lip Sync Smackdown for the Crown. After each elimination, the Queens dish and kiki as they wait to see who will take home the Crown.

shows.name: RuPaul's Drag Race UK

episodes.name: Meet the Queens: Series 1
episodes.overview: Mama Ru has made the trip across the pond in search for a queen with the most charisma, uniqueness, nerve and talent in all the land. Here are our RuPaul's Drag Race UK queens!

episodes.name: It's a Wrap!

episodes.name: Meet the Queens: Series 2
