episodes.name: Queens on Lockdown
episodes.overview: A look into the lockdown lives of the queens of RuPaul's Drag Race UK when they were sent home for a seven-month break in filming due to the Covid-19 pandemic.

episodes.name: Meet the Queens: Series 3
episodes.overview: Ahead of RuPaul’s Drag Race UK series 3, it’s time to Meet the Queens! In this special preview, RuPaul introduces the hotly anticipated twelve new queens due to compete for the coveted title of The UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar. Snatch a glimpse of their charisma, beauty and varied skill sets as they share their dreams, ambitions and fears for the forthcoming competition. Place your bets now and may the best Drag Queen win!

episodes.name: Meet the Queens: Series 4
episodes.overview: Ahead of the return of the next series of RuPaul’s Drag Race UK Series 4, get ready to meet the queens! RuPaul unleashes a brand new cast, introducing 12 fabulous new queens ready to compete for the title of the UK’s next Drag Race superstar.  Here the queens flash their uniqueness, charisma, nerve and talent for all to see as they share their hopes - and fears - about what the competition may have in store. May the best Drag Queen win!

episodes.name: Meet the Queens: Series 5
episodes.overview: RuPaul presents the new queens competing to be the UK’s next Drag Race superstar.

seasons.name: Series 1
seasons.overview: RuPaul brings the award-winning global phenomenon to the UK for the first time. Ten of the country’s most fabulous drag queens will compete in the Olympics of drag in the hope that RuPaul, queen of queens, will crown them as the UK’s first Drag Race Superstar.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Ten of the UK's most fabulous drag queens will compete in the Olympics of drag in the hope that RuPaul, queen of queens, will crown them as the UK’s first Drag Race superstar.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: The queens' acting skills are put to the test as they star in a sumptuous new comedy costume drama – Downton Draggy.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: This week RuPaul tests the queens’ sewing skills and fashion sense as they are challenged to create show stopping outfits from junk found at a car boot sale.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: This week the queens take on the iconic Snatch Game challenge where they must deliver their best celebrity impersonations against a classic TV game show backdrop.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: The remaining queens are split into two teams for a girl group battle.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: This week the queens’ creative marketing skills are put to the test as they are asked to create an advert and brand themselves.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Only four queens remain. Tensions are high and emotions are charged as they are challenged to give family members a very special drag makeover.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Strictly Come Dancing’s AJ Pritchard and his brother Curtis choreograph the three queens as they take on an all-singing, all-dancing final challenge.

seasons.name: Series 2
seasons.overview: The award winning RuPaul’s Drag Race UK returns for a second series. Over the course of ten weeks twelve of the country’s most fabulous drag queens will compete to be crowned the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: The queens enter the werk room for the first time and quickly take on their first challenge – a photo shoot with Ru. Then, in an added twist, the queens are asked to serve two looks on the Drag Race runway. Actress and fashion icon Elizabeth Hurley joins Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel as the first queen sashays away from the competition.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: RuPaul’s search for the UK’s next Drag Race superstar continues. The queens are settling in, but the pressure is on as their singing, acting and dancing skills are truly challenged in Rats – The Rusical, Drag Race’s first ever live musical. West End star Sheridan Smith joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel as another queen exits the competition.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The search for the UK's Next Drag Race Superstar continues. This week RuPaul tests the queens' creative sewing skills – and their friendships – as they're pitted against each other in a design challenge called Who Wore it Best? Supermodel Jourdan Dunn joins Michelle Visage and Graham Norton as a third queen leaves the competition.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: RuPaul’s search for the UK’s next Drag Race superstar continues. This week, the queens’ presenting skills are challenged as they host their own daytime magazine show, Morning Glory. The queen of British daytime TV, Lorraine Kelly, joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel as a fourth queen exits the competition.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: RuPaul and the queens return from their lockdown hiatus and the search for the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar resumes. With the queens reunited and added twists, there is much excitement in the air, but the competition picks up quickly as the queens form two groups for a Europop battle – The RuRuvision Song Contest. In a glorious homage to Eurovision, the queens record and perform the same catchy song, but can they swerve the dreaded nul points?! MNEK joins Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel as a fifth queen sashays away from the competition.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: This week the queens showcase their best celebrity impressions and improv skills, as they take on the iconic Snatch Game. Gemma Collins plays along too, but can the queens match her blankety blank? On the judging panel singer Jessie Ware joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr as another queen sashays away...

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: This week, RuPaul challenges the queens to create show-stopping superhero outfits. US Drag Race star Raven pops in for moral support, and TV presenter Maya Jama joins Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel, as Ru decides which queens should lip sync for their lives.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: This week the queens face one of their toughest challenge, yet as they are asked to write and perform their own comedy stand up routines. Comedy legend Dawn French joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel as another queen takes her leave.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: This week the queens’ acting skills are put to the test as they star in a new soap opera BeastEnders. To help them with their roles, EastEnders legend Natalie Cassidy, aka Sonia, gives the girls a soap acting masterclass whilst Michelle Visage and Graham Norton and an extra special guest judge join RuPaul to deliberate the fate of the remaining queens.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: It’s the Finale! The competition concludes in an all singing all dancing extravaganza fight for the crown. Choreographer Jay Revell coaches the queens through their intense final challenge, and Michelle Visage, Alan Carr, Graham Norton and all of the eliminated queens return to witness who RuPaul awards the coveted title of UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

seasons.name: Series 3
seasons.overview: The multi award winning RuPaul’s Drag Race UK is back for series 3! Over the course of ten weeks twelve fabulous drag queens will compete to be crowned The UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: In this opening episode, Judge Supremo, RuPaul ushers a brand new set of queens into the werk room, sets them their first cheeky challenge, and asks the queens to take to the runway to serve not one, but two looks. Comedy legend Matt Lucas joins Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: RuPaul’s search for the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar continues. The queens are settling in, but the pressure is on as their werk out skills are put to the test in the high energy dance challenge. Two-time Strictly champion Oti Mabuse puts the queens through their paces for the dance performance. Later, Oti joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The search for the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar continues. The queens camp it up as RuPaul tests their sewing skills – in a Great Outdoors themed design challenge. US Drag Race All Star Raven is on hand to offer the queens makeup advice while Bridgerton’s Nicola Coughlan joins Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the panel as a third queen leaves the competition.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The search for the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar steps up with the return of the now iconic Girl Group challenge. With on hand support from pop superstars Steps, the queens split into two groups to record and perform a brand new single. Spice Girls legend Emma Bunton joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: RuPaul’s search for the UK’s first Drag Race Superstar continues. This week the queens’ marketing skills are put to the test as they produce adverts for a brand new in-home smart assistant - Draglexa. Little Mix star Leigh-Anne Pinnock joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel as another queen exits the competition.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The search for the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar continues. This week the queens showcase their best celebrity impressions as they take on the ultimate comedy improv challenge - the Snatch Game. Loose Woman Judi Love and pop icon Nadine Coyle join in the fun.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: In a Drag Race first, Ru tests the queens’ showstopping stamina as they are challenged to serve three separate looks on the runway - all against the clock. The pressure is on, but thankfully fashion icon and internet sensation Charity Shop Sue is on hand to share her extensive fashion retail experience.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: This week the queens’ over acting skills are put to the test as they star in a new sci-fi blockbuster: Bra Wars - The Fempire Claps Back. Actor, Russell Tovey joins RuPaul as his extra special guest judge, alongside Michelle Visage and Graham Norton as the queens once again fight for their survival.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: It’s the Semi Finals! The remaining queens take to the mic, writing their own material for a stand up comedy challenge that sees them roasting the most challenging of victims - themselves. Comedy legend Kathy Burke joins RuPaul as his extra special guest judge alongside, Michelle Visage and Alan Carr as another queen is asked to sashay away.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: It’s the grand finale, and a Christmas wish is about to come true for one lucky queen, as the search to find the UK’s Next Drag Race superstar concludes with a festive fight for the crown. Choreographer Jay Revell returns to coach the finalists through their all singing, all dancing final challenge, while Michelle Visage, Alan Carr, Graham Norton are on hand as RuPaul chooses his winner and awards the coveted title of UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

seasons.name: Series 4
seasons.overview: RuPaul presides as twelve queens compete to be crowned the next Drag Race UK superstar.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Twelve fabulous new drag queens enter the werk room for the first time. Dame Joanna Lumley joins Michelle Visage and Graham Norton as RuPaul determines which queen is the first to go.

episodes.overview: Girl Group week comes early! FKA twigs joins Ru, Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the panel, and Cathy Dennis pops by to share her song writing wisdom.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Supermodel Leomie Anderson joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel as the queens tackle a bingo-themed design challenge.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The queens’ improv skills are tested as they star on Alan Carr’s chat show Catty Man. Queen of daytime TV Alison Hammond guest judges.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: It’s Rusical week! Star of stage and screen Hannah Waddingham joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel as the curtain falls on another queen.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Strictly stars Tess Daly and AJ Odudu play the iconic Snatch Game, while Spice Girl Mel B joins RuPaul as his extra special guest judge alongside Michelle Visage and Alan Carr.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: It’s the return of the much-loved makeover challenge as the queens share the art of drag with six very special makeover subjects. Boy George and US Drag Race star Raven join the fun.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: The queens’ acting skills are tested as they star in a murderous twist on a reality TV classic. Celebrity chef Lorraine Pascale guest-judges alongside Michelle Visage and Alan Carr.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: The queens' stand-up skills are tested as they campaign for a place in the grand finale. Comedy star Aisling Bea and actor and singer Olly Alexander guest-star.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: It’s the grand finale! Michelle Visage, Alan Carr, Graham Norton and the eliminated queens are all on hand as RuPaul crowns the UK’s next Drag Race superstar.

seasons.name: Series 5
seasons.overview: A brand spanking new series of RuPaul’s Drag Race UK returns! Over the next ten weeks, a cast of fabulous new drag queens will compete for RuPaul’s seal of approval and the much coveted title of UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: A new cast of queens enter the workroom and RuPaul sets their first surprise challenge. Supermodel Kristen McMenamy, Michelle Visage and Alan Carr join Ru on the judging panel.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Editor of British Vogue Edward Enninful and Heartstopper star Yasmin Finney drop by to help RuPaul as the queens showcase their creative skill and style in the design challenge.

episodes.overview: A hot new cast of queens enter the werk room as RuPaul kicks off his legendary race. And ooh la la, Alison Goldfrapp, Michelle Visage and Alan Carr join Ru on the judging panel.

episodes.overview: Supermodel Kristen McMenamy joins Mama Ru, Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel as the queens are asked to turn rags into riches for the iconic Design Challenge!

episodes.overview: It's the semi-finals! Derry Girls' Siobhan McSweeney joins Ru as he asks the queens to show off their best stand-up skills in a roast challenge to secure a place in the finale.

seasons.name: Series 7
seasons.overview: Rest Easy. Mama's back! Start your engines, as a brand new set of fabulous queens enter the werkroom, hoping to win Mama Ru's seal of approval and take home the crown.

episodes.name: Queens of the Brit Gala
episodes.overview: A hot new cast of queens enter the werk room as RuPaul kicks off his legendary race. Joel Dommett joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel.

episodes.name: Snatch Me Out!

episodes.overview: The queens give drag makeovers to hun legends Diane Parish, Shobna Gulati, Charlotte Church, Michelle McManus, Dani Harmer and David Potts. Mutya Buena joins the judging panel.

episodes.overview: It's the semi-finals! BAFTA winner Sophie Willan joins RuPaul as the queens to show off their best stand-up skills in a roast challenge to secure a place in the finale.

episodes.name: Sing for the Crown
episodes.overview: It’s the grand finale! Michelle Visage, Alan Carr, Graham Norton and the eliminated queens are all on hand as RuPaul crowns the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

shows.name: RuPaul's Drag Race: Untucked
shows.overview: The access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway—the backstage bitchiness, the catfights, the struggles, the tears and the secrets. See what happens behind the scenes of RuPaul's Drag Race when the queens let their tucks breathe... and let their emotions flow.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the second season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: Gone with the Windows
episodes.overview: RuPaul narrates the behind-the-scenes of the contest to become America's Next Drag Superstar. Backstage, the queens dish on whose curtains outfit is worst. Things get intense when two queens have an explosive fight.

episodes.name: Starrbootylicious
episodes.overview: The girls critique their own performances; Nina offers to give up her immunity, and Tammie defends her performance.

episodes.name: Country Queens
episodes.overview: A drag queen gets torn apart backstage for not having the right country look. Things get personal when a queen is forced to defend herself. RuPaul narrates this behind-the-scenes world.

episodes.name: The Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The drag queens get catty over each other's celebrity impersonations. A doll lashes out when confronted. RuPaul narrates this behind-the-scenes world.

episodes.name: Here Comes the Bride
episodes.overview: While the judges deliberate, tempers flare as the drag queens engage in a fierce argument over their wedding day challenge. RuPaul narrates this behind-the-scenes world.

episodes.name: Rocker Chicks
episodes.overview: The drag queens blast each other's rock and roll outfits. A queen is bitterly disappointed with her live singing performance. RuPaul narrates this behind-the-scenes world.

episodes.name: Once Upon a Queen
episodes.overview: The drag queens get critical over each other's book launch party outfits. Jealousies emerge over who gets the most praise from the judges. RuPaul narrates this behind-the-scenes world.

episodes.name: Golden Gals
episodes.overview: The queens dish the dirt on the drag mothers they transformed in this week's challenge. A queen reveals a little too much about the mother she was assigned. RuPaul narrates this behind-the-scenes world.

episodes.name: The Diva Awards
episodes.overview: The final four queens air out their disagreements backstage. A queen finally confronts another queen over a long-running feud. RuPaul narrates this behind-the-scenes world.

episodes.name: The Grand Finale
episodes.overview: The last 3 queens wait nervously to find out who has won the title of America's Next Drag Superstar. The queens get catty one last time as they review all the girls eliminated before them. RuPaul narrates this behind-the-scenes world.

seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the third season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: The Queen Who Mopped Xmas
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes of the contest to become America's Next Drag Superstar. Backstage, the queens dish on the holiday inspired drag looks that sleighed the judges and the frocks that received frozen reactions.

episodes.name: Queens in Space
episodes.overview: While the judges deliberate, wigs come off and cocktails get thrown in an explosive battle.

episodes.name: Totally Leotarded
episodes.overview: A drag queen gets torn apart backstage for being a know-it-all during the exercise video challenge. Things get personal when the queens discuss their love lives.

episodes.name: QNN News
episodes.overview: Backstage chat turns into a heated fight as the queens debate one of the more controversial performances.

episodes.name: The Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The drag queens get catty over each other's celebrity impersonations.

episodes.name: Face, Face, Face of Cakes
episodes.overview: While the judges deliberate, tempers flare as the drag queens engage in a fierce argument over their cake dress challenge.

episodes.name: Ru Ha Ha
episodes.overview: A queen is bitterly disappointed with her comedy performance, and backstage drama reaches an all time high when a queen refuses to lip synch.

episodes.name: Life, Liberty and the Pursuit of Style
episodes.overview: The queens Public Service Announcements inspire them to discuss gays in the army.

episodes.name: RuPaul-a-Palooza
episodes.overview: The queens angrily confront each other backstage, after RuPaul asks them to nominate a fellow queen to leave the competition.

episodes.name: RuPaul's Hair Extravaganza
episodes.overview: The drag queens get critical over each other's hair ball looks.

episodes.name: Jocks in Frocks
episodes.overview: The queens dish the dirt on the jocks they transformed.

episodes.name: Make Dat Money
episodes.overview: The final four queens air out their disagreements backstage.

episodes.name: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: The last 3 queens wait nervously to find out who has won the title of America's Next Drag Superstar, and a cash prize of $75,000.

episodes.name: RuPaul's Big Opening: Part 2

episodes.name: Scream Queens
episodes.overview: One of the queens deals with being singled out as the girl most in need of being sent home from the competition. Plus the queens must open four pink boxes containing scary surprises.

episodes.name: Shade: The Rusical
episodes.overview: A video message causes unexpected drama in the lounge.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: One of the queens reveals a personal secret that may explain her attitude in the competition.

episodes.name: Oh No She Betta Don't
episodes.overview: A former queen leaves behind an outrageous surprise.

episodes.name: Glamazon By Colorevolution
episodes.overview: One of the queens is heartbroken when her idol reads her look.

episodes.name: Drag Queens of Comedy
episodes.overview: It's chaos in the lounge when one of the queens is devastated and threatens to leave the competition.

episodes.name: Queens of Talk
episodes.overview: As the competition intensifies, one of the queens begins to show her shady side to the others.

episodes.name: Drag My Wedding
episodes.overview: The makeovers have an effect on the brides who start reading their competition.

episodes.name: Glitter Ball
episodes.overview: There is fallout in the lounge after one queen accuses another of "sailing" through the race.

episodes.name: Sissy That Walk
episodes.overview: Following their final challenge, the queens head to the Untucked lounge one last time.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the seventh season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: Born Naked
episodes.overview: The Untucked Season Premiere takes us backstage as the queens face their worst fear: a naked runway! Tensions run high as their interpretations of the challenge are questioned.

episodes.name: Glamazionian Airways
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, drama ensues, as the queens defend their Glamazonian Airways safety videos. The claws come out when they attack each other’s style.

episodes.name: ShakesQueer
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, things get hairy as the queens throw shade and blame on a Shakespearean level.

episodes.name: Spoof! (There It Is)
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, bonds are forming, and the queens face lip-synching against their friends when their parody music videos hit a flat note.

episodes.name: The Despy Awards
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, tempers boil and personalities clash after the queens' comedy skills are put to the test as awards show presenters. A message from home for one of the queens takes everyone on an emotional ride.

episodes.name: Ru Hollywood Stories
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, the tension is deadly after the queens’ Ru Hollywood Stories re-enactment challenge.

episodes.name: The Snatch Game
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, drama unfolds as the queens discuss who hit the mark and who fell short with their celebrity impersonations.

episodes.name: Conjoined Twins
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, the conjoined twins get torn apart. Things get intense as one eliminated queen hopes she’s done enough to re-enter the competition.

episodes.name: Divine Inspiration
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, things get ugly as friendships are put to the test and rivalries are heightened. The queens need some Divine intervention.

episodes.name: Prancing Queens
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, the queens tell the “T" about being homesick. A queen gets a surprise message from a RuPaul’s Drag Race alumnus.

episodes.name: Hello, Kitty Girls!
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, the queens dish about their struggles with the challenges and the judges. With only five queens remaining, the eliminations are getting emotional.

episodes.name: And the Rest Is Drag
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes, tempers flare, as the competition to be America’s Next Drag Superstar narrows. The queens are set to boil as they battle for a position in the top three.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the eighth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: Keeping It 100!
episodes.overview: The 100th episode of RuPaul's Drag Race is already off to a shady start! The Queens get to know each other and talk about who's on top and who's on bottom and have a runway critique all their own. Alliances develop, but tempers start to flare as the queens talk about their runway looks.

episodes.name: Bitch Perfect
episodes.overview: After a Bitch Perfect musical extravaganza, the queens untuck backstage and the bitching really begins. As the queens discuss each other's runway looks and how the judges are living for Kim Chi and Acid Betty's looks, Bob proclaims black is the new nude. It becomes all about the suspect padding of Dax's posterior and Ru seems to have double vision.

episodes.name: RuCo’s Empire
episodes.overview: After the queens roll their way through an Empire of a challenge, they untuck backstage and Naysha is established as the second queen in herstory to come back and stay. Chi Chi gets spicy and has the other queens rolling with her southern charm, y'all. Cynthia gets a short fashion lesson from the other queens and Kim Chi gets a special message from a living doll back at home.

episodes.name: New Wave Queens
episodes.overview: The queens untuck after a new wave battle of the bands. Backstage it’s a punk girl, new wave chick square off as the queens butt heads over their looks and performances. One of our queens breaks down after she gets a message from home and it gives the other queens an emotional look into her life.

episodes.name: Supermodel Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens kiki backstage about what the judges thought of their Snatch Game characters and Madonna runway looks. One queen’s sister sends a message of support from back home and another queen gets fashion silhouette advice. Chanel Iman and Gigi Hadid cause a commotion when they pay the queens a backstage visit.

episodes.name: Wizards of Drag
episodes.overview: After strutting down the yellow brick road, the queens untuck and the broomsticks come out. Two queens dive into a stitches verses hot glue shade throwing standoff. The queens' Little Women join them and bring along some big opinions. Honey, we are not in Kansas anymore.

episodes.name: Shady Politics
episodes.overview: The queens untuck backstage waiting for the votes to be tallied on their presidential campaigns. The shade becomes very political as they discuss the judge’s critiques and see everything isn’t always black and white.

episodes.name: RuPaul Book Ball
episodes.overview: After a triple runway at RuPaul’s Book Ball, the queens untuck and read each other cover to cover. One of our queens is shaken after her cardboard cutouts fail to impress the judges, and the other queens are not shy about giving her some "friendly" advice.

episodes.name: The Realness
episodes.overview: After the last chance runway, it's final four time in the Untucked Lounge. The queens critique one another's final speeches to the judges and one queen gets a herstory lesson. But do they all believe the most deserving queens made it to the top four?

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the ninth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: Oh. My. Gaga!
episodes.overview: RuPaul's Drag Race is off to a stellar start! It's a love fest as the queens get to know each other and talk about their runway looks. Before heading back to the main stage, the queens get a backstage visit that leaves them gagged.

episodes.name: She Done Already Done Brought It On
episodes.overview: After cheering each other through possibly the most physical challenge in Drag Race herstory, the queens untuck and discuss the judge’s opinions of their looks and performances. The reality of who’s on top and who’s on bottom settles in because for the first time this season, someone will sashay away.

episodes.name: Draggily Ever After
episodes.overview: After a fairytale runway fit for a princess, the Queens untuck backstage and ki-ki about who they’d “kai-kai” with. One queen who thinks her happily ever after will be in the top is thrown when being in the bottom becomes a reality.

episodes.name: Good Morning Bitches
episodes.overview: After the queens get naughty on the runway, they settle in backstage. The safe Queens spill the T on their looks and talk about whose runway didn’t impress. When the other queens join, things backstage start getting shady.

episodes.name: Reality Stars: The Musical
episodes.overview: After the queens pay tribute to America’s favorite family, The Kardashians, in a musical extravaganza, they untuck backstage. One accuses the others of sabotage as the bottom queens prepare to lip-sync.

episodes.name: Snatch Game.
episodes.overview: The queens settle in after a star-studded snatch game and it gets real when two queens go at each other about who should be in the bottom two.

episodes.name: 9021-HO
episodes.overview: After the queens’ successful acting debut they untuck backstage. The sisterhood builds stronger bonds after a queen gets a message from back home.

episodes.name: RuPaul Roast
episodes.overview: The queens cool down backstage after the RuPaul Roast. They discuss which queens of comedy were on fire and which ones went down in flames.

episodes.name: Your Pilot’s on Fire
episodes.overview: After making their own TV pilots, the queens settle in and get shady about who might get the green light and who might be canceled.

episodes.name: Makeovers: Crew Better Work
episodes.overview: After teaching the crew to beat their mugs and strut the runway, they untuck backstage and kiki with their new sisters.

episodes.name: Gayest Ball Ever
episodes.overview: The queens untuck after the Gayest Ball Ever. Emotions run high as the top 5 discuss their runway looks and who might be top 4.

episodes.name: Category Is
episodes.overview: After the facing their final challenges, the queens untuck backstage and kiki about how this experience has changed them and the legacy they hope to leave.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the tenth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: 10s Across the Board
episodes.overview: The Queens untuck backstage and spill the T. Christina Aguilera pays them a gag-worthy visit before our first Queen sashays away.

episodes.name: PharmaRusical
episodes.overview: The queens must wow the judges in a lip-sync, dance number inspired by pharmaceutical TV ads; Halsey and Padma Lakshmi guest judge; guests Andy Cohen and Alyssa Edwards.

episodes.name: Tap That App
episodes.overview: The Queens untuck and discuss the struggles of this weeks challenge. Feathers fly over whether or not a certain queen brought her best drag.

episodes.name: The Last Ball on Earth
episodes.overview: Underlying tension between two queens reaches its boiling point, and another queen struggles to deal with the judges’ critiques.

episodes.name: The Bossy Rossy Show
episodes.overview: The queens settle in after a bossy challenge and spill the tea on boyfriends, attractions and who they think should be packing up.

episodes.name: Drag Con Panel Extravaganza
episodes.overview: The queens untuck backstage and discuss difficult moments from their past, and one queen comes to terms with a traumatic moment that changed her life.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: Things heat up in Untucked after the Queens throw each other under the bus on the main stage. Feeling betrayed by her closest friends in the competition, one Queen fights harder to hold on to her dreams.

episodes.name: The Unauthorized Rusical
episodes.overview: The queens pay tribute to one of the greatest stars of all time in Cher: The Unauthorized Rusical. Andrew Rannells and Billy Eichner guest judge.

episodes.name: Breastworld
episodes.overview: When the queens untuck backstage, Miz Cracker gets to see a touching video from her family, and Kameron Michaels struggles with feeling discouraged.

episodes.name: Social Media Kings Into Queens
episodes.overview: The queens welcome unexpected guests backstage for some kiki and real talk, and one queen admits that she upped her strategy game.

episodes.name: Evil Twins
episodes.overview: The queens are beside themselves after the week’s challenge. One queen is close to giving up, and a strong queen is unexpectedly heartbroken by the words of another.

episodes.name: American
episodes.overview: The final four Queens share their dreams of making it to the finale and how much they’ve grown in the competition. A surprise message hits close to home for everyone.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the eleventh season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: Whatcha Unpackin?
episodes.overview: The Season 11 contestants chat backstage for the first time and have a surprise kiki with guest judge Miley Cyrus, and the first eliminated queen has an emotional pack-up.

episodes.name: Good God Girl, Get Out
episodes.overview: After the Good God, Girl, Get Out challenge and zodiac runway, Silky talks about the struggles of being a plus-size queen, and Bobby Moynihan shows off his death-drop skills.

episodes.name: Diva Worship
episodes.overview: After the Diva Worship challenge, Silky Ganache explains why the religious aspect of the competition made her uncomfortable, and Troye Sivan and Guillermo Diaz head backstage.

episodes.name: Trump: The Rusical
episodes.overview: After their Trump-inspired Rusical, Scarlet Envy discusses her tense relationship with Yvie Oddly, and Tiffany Pollard probes the queens about a possible backstage romance.

episodes.name: Monster Ball
episodes.overview: After competing in the monster-inspired ball, Nina West shares her coming out story, Shuga Cain gets a heartfelt message from her fiance, and Elvira drops in to see the girls.

episodes.name: The Draglympics
episodes.overview: After the Draglympics challenge, Yvie Oddly details her ankle injury, Silky Ganache and Plastique Tiara spar over leftover wigs, and Adam Rippon and Mirai Nagasu drop in.

episodes.name: From Farm To Runway
episodes.overview: After the farm-to-runway challenge, Yvie Oddly and Silky Ganache let out their werkroom frustrations, Plastique Tiara's boyfriend phones in, and Brooke Lynn dodges drama.

episodes.name: Snatch Game at Sea
episodes.overview: Plastique Tiara addresses Ra'Jah O'Hara's accusations, the queens reflect on their Snatch Game performances, and Yvie Oddly and A'Keria Davenport get messages from home.

episodes.name: L.A.D.P.!
episodes.overview: While untucking after the LADP! challenge, Natasha Lyonne drops in, Silky Ganache gets a message from back home, and the bottom queens share a moment before their lip sync.

episodes.name: Dragracadabra
episodes.overview: After putting on magic shows, Vanessa Vanjie and Yvie Oddly sort out a tense moment from the runway, Brooke Lynn Hytes gets a message from home, and another queen goes home.

episodes.name: Bring Back My Queens!
episodes.overview: After the makeover challenge, Yvie Oddly defends her attitude, Silky Ganache gets emotional over Brooke Lynn Hytes's critiques, and Vanessa Vanjie gets a message from home.

episodes.name: Queens Everywhere
episodes.overview: After the season's final challenge, Silky Ganache and A'Keria Davenport open up about their insecurities, and Vanessa Vanjie Mateo and Brooke Lynn Hytes share a tender moment.

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the twelfth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: I'm That Bitch
episodes.overview: After the first seven Season 12 queens rap in a girl group number, Widow Von'Du calls out her difficult teammates, and Nicki Minaj drops in with makeup and performance advice.

episodes.name: You Don’t Know Me
episodes.overview: After the final set of queens perform a musical number, Rock M. Sakura gets emotional reflecting on the challenge, and Robyn gives the girls advice on creative collaboration.

episodes.name: World's Worst
episodes.overview: After the queens compete on a parody TV talent show, Crystal Methyd gets a confidence boost after some harsh critiques, and Nicky Doll fights back against her inner saboteur

episodes.name: The Ball Ball
episodes.overview: The queens are on the ball this week but the bottoms are not ready to bounce. One queen sees simplicity where others see a lazy attempt at style. Leslie Jones drops in for a kiki.

episodes.name: Gay's Anatomy
episodes.overview: After the queens act in a Grey's Anatomy parody sketch, Aiden Zhane is forced to defend her performance, and Brita gets emotional over her standing in the competition.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: Miss Vanjie drops by to visit this week’s safe queens. Tempers flare over the Snatch Game, but Jonathan Bennet and Daniel Franzese stop by and turn these mean girls around.

episodes.name: Madonna: The Unauthorized Rusical
episodes.overview: Safe queens settle and discuss the past week’s conflicts. One queen confronts another over a shady comment and it causes a commotion. U.S. Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez stops by to discuss the politics of drag.

episodes.name: Droop
episodes.overview: It’s a somber beginning as the queens discuss their answers to Ru’s question of who should go home this week. Chaka Khan pops in to perk the queens up and remind them that they are every woman.

episodes.name: Choices 2020
episodes.overview: After the queens campaign for president, Gigi Goode owns up to being apolitical, Jackie Cox discusses Muslim visibility, and Widow Von'Du gets defensive about her performance.

episodes.name: Superfan Makeover
episodes.overview: After the queens make over Drag Race superfans, Heidi N Closet discusses her goals in the competition, Jaida Essence Hall reflects on drag fandom, and Daisy Ridley drops by.

episodes.name: One-Queen Show
episodes.overview: After the queens perform one-woman shows, Jackie Cox calls out Jaida Essence Hall for not being honest on the runway, and Whoopi Goldberg shares her words of wisdom.

episodes.name: Viva Drag Vegas
episodes.overview: After performing a Las Vegas-style musical medley in the season's last challenge, the queens reflect on their Top Five status and relive their favorite Untucked moments.

seasons.name: Season 12
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the thirteenth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: The Pork Chop
episodes.overview: After the queens kick off Season 13 with a series off-lipsync battles, Tamisha Iman reveals why she dropped out of Season 12, and Symone discusses the inspiration behind her entrance lewk.

episodes.name: Condragulations
episodes.overview: After the queens perform Condragulations, Kandy Muse gets emotional over her critiques, Elliott with 2 Ts reflects on her journey, and Gottmik comes out to the group as transmasculine.

episodes.name: Phenomenon
episodes.overview: Backstage in Untucked, the queens open up about their families and the fear of not being accepted. A queen comes to terms with the possibility that she may have to fight to stay in the competition.

episodes.name: RuPaulmark Channel
episodes.overview: After a challenging group performance, the queens size up the competition. While a queen gets called out for being safe, the bottom queens face the fact that one of them might be going home tonight.

episodes.name: The Bag Ball
episodes.overview: After the Bag Ball, some of the safe queens question the tops, Kandy Muse offers up (more) unsolicited advice to Elliott with 2 Ts, and Tamisha Iman gets blunt about her competition.

episodes.name: Disco-Mentary
episodes.overview: After the queens' disco performances, Rose opens up about her frustrations in the competition, Gottmik gets emotional watching a message from her parents, and two one-time rivals make peace.

episodes.name: Bossy Rossy Ruboot
episodes.overview: After the queens' trashy talk show improv challenge, Denali expresses frustration at not being in the top once again, and Kandy Muse gives Elliott with 2 Ts a pep talk.

episodes.name: Social Media: The Unverified Rusical
episodes.overview: After the queens star in a social media-themed musical, Olivia Lux does a backstage ruveal, Rose and Denali clear the air after fighting over a role, and the bottoms prepare for battle.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens weigh in on each other's Snatch Game performances, Olivia Lux and Rose question Utica's unflattering off-camera behavior, and Ts Madison drops by for a pep talk.

episodes.name: Freaky Friday Queens
episodes.overview: After the makeover challenge, the queens vent over having to call out one of their sisters, Denali and Olivia Lux get emotional at the idea of leaving, and Kandy Muse gets a moving message.

episodes.name: Pop! Goes the Queens
episodes.overview: After a soda branding challenge, Olivia Lux admits she feels overlooked, the queens reveal their top competition, and Tina Burner gets a message from her mom.

episodes.name: Nice Girls Roast
episodes.overview: After the roast challenge, Gottmik reflects on her growth in the competition, and former Miss Congeniality winners Nina West, Valentina and Heidi N Closet drop in to chat with the queens.

episodes.name: Henny, I Shrunk the Drag Queens!
episodes.overview: After their star turns in a sci-fi spoof, Olivia Lux feels the sting of the other queens' critiques, Kandy Muse needs medical attention, and Cynthia Erivo pops in to chat with the girls.

episodes.name: Gettin' Lucky
episodes.overview: After performing in the season's last challenge, the queens react to seeing their baby photos and addressing their younger selves, and Rose and Symone receive messages of support from home.

seasons.name: Season 13
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the fourteenth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: Big Opening No. 1
episodes.overview: Seven queens untuck and kiki about their performances in the first Maxi Challenge. Sisterly bonds build, as they discuss the art of drag and the trouble with first impressions.

episodes.name: Big Opening No. 2
episodes.overview: Seven new queens untuck and hash out the struggles of their first week in the competition. After hearing the others' stories, one queen shares how her drag journey is different from theirs.

episodes.name: A Pair of Balls
episodes.overview: With all the Season 14 queens together for the first time, the kiki heats up and cracks in the sisterhood begin to show.

episodes.name: She's a Super Tease
episodes.overview: The Maxi Challenge has the queens in their feelings as they discuss the week's placements. Emotions run raw, putting their sisterly bonds to the test.

episodes.name: Save a Queen
episodes.overview: Queens from seasons past return to Untucked to kiki with the Season 14 queens and give them advice on life after the competition. Safe queens question how they can break through to get the judges’ attention.

episodes.name: Glamazon Prime
episodes.overview: Tensions run high after an unconventional runway gets some of the queens in their feelings. A kiki with guest judge Taraji P. Henson inspires the queens and gets them primed for the lip sync.

episodes.name: The Daytona Wind
episodes.overview: The competition strengthens the bonds between the queens. Guest Ts Madison stops by for a little sisterly advice, and one queen reveals a truth she can’t keep hidden any longer.

episodes.name: 60s Girl Groups
episodes.overview: After spilling their hearts on the runway, the queens bond as they reminisce about their time in the competition. It’s an emotional moment as the bottoms discuss the possibility of sashaying away.

episodes.name: Menzeses
episodes.overview: A DragCon challenge has the queens baring it all. Guest judge Nicole Byer gets everyone roaring with laughter, and the bottom queens prepare for a battle royal.

episodes.name: Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens weigh in on their Snatch Game impersonations and debate whose performance was a total bottom. An emotional video from home lifts the spirits of one queen and a kiki with Dove Cameron hits home for all.

episodes.name: An Extra Special Episode
episodes.overview: After a Lip Sync Lalaparuza Smackdown, the queens reflect on their memorably lackluster Snatch Game performances, and Angeria Paris VanMicheals gives Daya Betty constructive feedback.

episodes.name: Moulin Ru: The Rusical
episodes.overview: After the queens' Moulin Rouge! parody performance, Jorgeous prepares for the worst, Bosco and Lady Camden talk it out after having a pre-challenge tiff, and Andra Day drops by backstage.

episodes.name: The Ross Mathews Roast
episodes.overview: After Ross Mathews gets roasted, DeJa Skye gets emotional thinking about her coaching session, Willow Pill gets a message from home, and Dulcé Sloan gets a pulse check on the queens.

episodes.name: Catwalk
episodes.overview: After performing in their final challenge, the queens discuss addressing their younger selves, rate their chances of making the finale, and recall their favorite moments of the competition.

seasons.name: Season 14
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the fifteenth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: One Night Only (1)
episodes.overview: The cameras go backstage to meet the 16 new queens as they prepare to introduce themselves to the world in their werk room entrances and begin their first challenge.

episodes.name: One Night Only (2)
episodes.overview: The queens take time to get to know each other after a talent show challenge, Ariana Grande visits backstage, and the first to depart lets her voice be heard before her sashay.

episodes.name: All Queens Go to Heaven
episodes.overview: After the queens film ads for Heaven, Mistress Isabelle Brooks gives makeup advice, Princess Poppy explains her approach to the competition, and Maren Morris doles out words of wisdom.

episodes.name: Supersized Snatch Game
episodes.overview: The queens assess their Snatch Game performances, Malaysia Babydoll Foxx grapples with old insecurities, and Sugar and Spice strategize how to express their individuality as drag twins.

episodes.name: House of Fashion
episodes.overview: The queens are stitched, glued and gooped after turning home décor into haute couture. A kiki with Janelle Monáe reminds them how inspiring they are to others.

episodes.name: Old Friends Gold
episodes.overview: The temperature rises backstage following a heated Girl Group challenge that leaves the queens shaken, rattled and rolled. Sage advice from some old friends remind our queens of the importance of friends and chosen family.

episodes.name: The Daytona Wind 2
episodes.overview: After the winds settle the queens untuck and discuss the art of comedic timing. Harvey Guillen drops in and gives the queens some valuable advice.

episodes.name: LipSync Lalaparuza Smackdown
episodes.overview: The queens kiki after a dramatic LipSync Lalaparuza Smackdown and debate who is proving to be the fiercest at this halfway point in the competition.

episodes.name: The Crystal Ball
episodes.overview: After a ball challenge, Malaysia Babydoll Foxx compliments her fellow competitors' design skills, Mistress Isabelle Brooks gets real with Spice, and Julia Garner visits backstage.

episodes.name: 50/50's Most Gagworthy Stars
episodes.overview: Many queens possess the gift of gab, but some were left speechless after this week’s talk show segments. Ts Madison stops by to discuss the judges critiques and lift some spirits.

episodes.name: Two Queens, One Jok
episodes.overview: The queens yuck it up backstage following the comedy challenge, but the laughter soon gives way to tears. Comedian Ali Wong stops by for a kiki with the queens.

episodes.name: Wigloose: The Rusical!
episodes.overview: After cutting loose in the Rusical, tensions flare as the queens hash out their answers to Ru's question.

episodes.name: Teacher Makeovers
episodes.overview: After the queens make over teachers, Loosey LaDuca lets off some steam, the queens assess their drag family resemblances, and Sasha Colby gets a message from Drag Race alum Kerri Colby.

episodes.name: Blame It on the Edit
episodes.overview: After the intergalactic music video premiere, the final four queens reflect on their achievements over the season and recount their proudest and least favorite moments of the competition.

seasons.name: Season 15
seasons.overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway of the sixteenth season of RuPaul's Drag Race.

episodes.name: Rate-A-Queen
episodes.overview: The queens toast to a new season and discuss Xunami Muse's catchy song, Mirage's fabulous dance moves and O's stunning costume, and guest judge Charlize Theron joins for a heart-to-heart.

episodes.name: Queen Choice Awards
episodes.overview: The queens unwind and discuss Mhi'ya Iman LePaige's showstopping flips, Nymphia Wind's gag-worthy ruveal, and Megami's solemn performance, and Becky G drops in with encouraging words.

episodes.name: The Mother of All Balls
episodes.overview: The lounge gets tense as the queens offer each other brutally honest and unsolicited critiques, and the first to be eliminated proudly stands by her runway looks.

episodes.name: RDR Live!

episodes.name: How's Your Headliner?
episodes.overview: The top Queens enter the Untucked lounge for the final time. Their fates are uncertain, but they all agree that they have had the time of their lives. Guest judge, Tracee Ellis Ross stops by to thank the Queens for putting on an amazing show.

seasons.overview: Budding romance. A brand-new mall. And rabid rats running toward danger. It's the summer of 1985 in Hawkins ... and one summer can change everything.

episodes.name: Chapter One: Suzie, Do You Copy?
episodes.overview: Summer brings new jobs and budding romance. But the mood shifts when Dustin's radio picks up a Russian broadcast, and Will senses something is wrong.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Mall Rats
episodes.overview: Nancy and Jonathan follow a lead, Steve and Robin sign on to a secret mission, and Max and Eleven go shopping. A rattled Billy has troubling visions.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Case of the Missing Lifeguard
episodes.overview: With El and Max looking for Billy, Will declares a day without girls. Steve and Dustin go on a stakeout, and Joyce and Hopper return to Hawkins Lab.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: The Sauna Test
episodes.overview: A code red brings the gang back together to face a frighteningly familiar evil. Karen urges Nancy to keep digging, and Robin finds a useful map.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Flayed
episodes.overview: Strange surprises lurk inside an old farmhouse and deep beneath the Starcourt Mall. Meanwhile, the Mind Flayer is gathering strength.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: E Pluribus Unum
episodes.overview: Dr. Alexei reveals what the Russians have been building, and Eleven sees where Billy has been. Dustin and Erica stage a daring rescue.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Bite
episodes.overview: With time running out -- and an assassin close behind -- Hopper's crew races back to Hawkins, where El and the kids are preparing for war.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Battle of Starcourt
episodes.overview: Terror reigns in the food court when the Mind Flayer comes to collect. But down below, in the dark, the future of the world is at stake.

seasons.name: Stranger Things 4
seasons.overview: Darkness returns to Hawkins just in time for spring break, igniting fresh terror, disturbing memories — and an ominous new threat.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Hellfire Club
episodes.overview: El is bullied at school. Joyce opens a mysterious package. A scrappy player shakes up D&D night.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: Vecna's Curse
episodes.overview: A plane brings Mike to California — and a dead body brings Hawkins to a halt. Nancy goes looking for leads. A shaken Eddie tells the gang what he saw.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Monster and the Superhero
episodes.overview: Murray and Joyce fly to Alaska, and El faces serious consequences. Robin and Nancy dig up dirt on Hawkins' demons. Dr. Owens delivers sobering news.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Dear Billy
episodes.overview: Max is in grave danger... and running out of time. A patient at Pennhurst asylum has visitors. Elsewhere, in Russia, Hopper is hard at work.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Nina Project
episodes.overview: Owens takes El to Nevada, where she's forced to confront her past, while the Hawkins kids comb a crumbling house for clues. Vecna claims another victim.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Dive
episodes.overview: Behind the Iron Curtain, a risky rescue mission gets underway. The California crew seeks help from a hacker. Steve takes one for the team.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Massacre at Hawkins Lab
episodes.overview: As Hopper braces to battle a monster, Dustin dissects Vecna's motives — and decodes a message from beyond. El finds strength in a distant memory.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: Papa
episodes.overview: Nancy has sobering visions, and El passes an important test. Back in Hawkins, the gang gathers supplies and prepares for battle.

episodes.name: Chapter Nine: The Piggyback
episodes.overview: With selfless hearts and a clash of metal, heroes fight from every corner of the battlefield to save Hawkins — and the world itself.

seasons.name: Stranger Things 5
seasons.overview: The fall of 1987. Hawkins is scarred by rifts. Vecna has vanished and the government has placed the town under military quarantine, forcing Eleven back into hiding. To end this nightmare, they'll need everyone together, one last time.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Crawl
episodes.overview: November, 1987. The gang evades the military to scour the Upside Down for Vecna — but fails to notice a threat lurking closer to home.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Vanishing of...
episodes.overview: After a vicious attack at the Wheeler home, Mike and Nancy confront the cost of secrecy, while El and Hopper embark on a rescue mission.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Turnbow Trap
episodes.overview: Will gains unique insight into Vecna's next move, giving the crew an opportunity to set a trap. Holly explores her new surroundings.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Sorcerer
episodes.overview: The military tightens its grip on the town. Mike, Lucas and Robin orchestrate a daring escape. El comes face-to-face with the enemy.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Rightside Up
episodes.overview: Everyone stands together to end this nightmare, one last time.

shows.name: Hey Dude
shows.overview:
Hey Dude is an American Western comedy series that aired from 1989 to 1991. The show was broadcast on the Nickelodeon network, and aired reruns on Nickelodeon until early 1999, and now on TeenNick ever since late 2011. Hey Dude was Nickelodeon's second original live action television series, following the 1984 series Out of Control.

The series was set on the fictional "Bar None Dude Ranch" near the city of Tucson, Arizona. It portrayed the lives of the ranch's owner, his son, a female ranch hand, and four teenage summer employees. Hey Dude was a comedy geared towards a teenage audience.

The complete series have been released on DVD. Only the first four seasons are on iTunes.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In 1795, three teenage boys discovered a strange, man-made depression in the ground on Oak Island–a small, wooded island just off the coast of Nova Scotia, Canada. As the boys began to dig, they found a number of intriguing artifacts. It was the end of the piracy era and rumors of buried treasure were rampant. The boys’ discovery launched a treasure hunt that has spanned more than 200 years.The search had gone dormant, but last year, Rick and Marty Lagina, two brothers from Michigan with a life-long interest in the mystery, renewed the efforts to discover the legendary treasure.
